programme.title: Full Force Nature: Episode 112
programme.desc: A boat captain is left stranded on his vessel, and is forced to ride out Hurricane Katrina with his video camera in hand. Meanwhile, in nearby Kenner Louisiana the Kenner Fire Department struggles to extinguish blazes caused by exploding transformers

programme.title: Dom kallar oss raggare
programme.desc: Raggare! Enligt många ett skällsord! Visst har det varit mycket tumult med raggare genom åren. Det är Sveriges första tonårskultur som började i Stockholm redan på 50-talet

programme.title: Wild Germany: Forests
programme.desc: Shrouded in myth and legend, the forests of Germany and their wild inhabitants are world famous. Forests enters a world full of magic.

programme.title: Patti Smith: Dream of Life
programme.desc: En poetisk dokumentär om punkikonen Patti Smith, hennes liv, konst och engagemang, berättad genom musik och personliga bilder.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Mindy Cohn, Valerie Harper, Matthew Gray-Gubler, Nicole Eggert
programme.desc: Looking for the perfect sanctuary to finish her book, Mindy Cohn is confronted with anything but solitude at a famous Pasadena apartment building; while at a crossroads.
programme.sub-title: Mindy Cohn, Valerie Harper, Matthew Gray-Gubler, Nicole Eggert

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff
programme.desc: Nick will accompany John Griffin as he once again utilizes his innovative device at the Wildwood Sanitarium. This collaboration aims to see if Jeremy's spirit—or any other—will reveal itself and interact with the living.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: A winding system of caves makes Kentucky one of the most unique geological wonders in the world. Near the caves is Bethlehem Academy, a long-abandoned Catholic School that is being kept alive by a unique resident.

programme.title: My Haunted House: Vow of Silence and Cryptic
programme.desc: A single mother's new home was once a convent that kept a horrifying secret. A couple is tormented by the meaning of a date that keeps appearing in their new home.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Tracey Gold, Alice Cooper, Fred Dryer, Katherine Erbe
programme.desc: The spirit of a lonely child seeks refuge with Tracey Gold; and more.
programme.sub-title: Tracey Gold, Alice Cooper, Fred Dryer, Katherine Erbe

programme.title: A Haunting: Blood Visions
programme.desc: Faced with a supernatural threat, Betty Johnson and her family move hoping to leave their troubles behind. But when Betty’s oldest child starts experiencing bloody visions and is physically attacked, the family realizes "it" has followed them.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Patricia Velasquez, Susie Essman, Elya Baskin
programme.desc: Patricia is terrorized by a ghost who escapes from the pages of an antique book. Susie feels she has made the biggest mistake of her life but finds forgiveness and unconditional love from the spirit of her grandmother.
programme.sub-title: Patricia Velasquez, Susie Essman, Elya Baskin

programme.title: My Haunted House: The Nursery and The Closet
programme.desc: A dangerous entity stalks a pregnant woman in her new house. A single mother discovers a terrifying secret trapped in her son's closet. The shocking eyewitness accounts of terrified people whose dream homes have become nightmares.

programme.title: A Haunting: Death's Door
programme.desc: Victoria Dane was accidentally overdosed before an emergency surgery and flat-lined for more than seven minutes. While recovering, she starts to notice unusual occurrences. She fears that she’s opened a door to a paranormal world that can never be shut.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett
programme.desc: An investigation into the practice of past-life regression therapy; a technique where subjects are placed under hypnosis in order to recover memories of supposed past lives.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Ghosts of the Forgotten
programme.desc: The PRS investigation looks into the haunted Lake County Poor House, that for over a century and a half was a dumping ground for those society cast aside.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff
programme.desc: The Sweets Home Estate, owned by Ed Bowden, lies a fascinating yet eerie collection of haunted artifacts, each with its own story.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff: Lavaca Jail
programme.desc: Nick Groff spends two days in Hallettsville, Texas's haunted Old Lavaca County Jail.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: The Shroud of Turin
programme.desc: Is this famous piece of linen cloth the actual burial cloth of Jesus Christ or a clever Medieval hoax?

programme.title: A Haunting: Living Nightmare
programme.desc: Angela, a newlywed, is excited to start her new life with Stephen when nightmares that she experienced as a child suddenly resurface. Soon the menacing old hag from her dreams terrorizes her daughter and takes temporary possession of her son.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Giancarlo Esposito
programme.desc: Giancarlo Esposito (Breaking Bad / Revolution / The Usual Suspects) tells the story of his former home in Ridgefield, CT.

programme.title: Buzzfeed Unsolved: 3 Horrifying Cases of Ghosts and Demons
programme.desc: Join Ryan and Shane as they cover multiple cases and visit some of the most haunted places in the world.
programme.sub-title: 3 Horrifying Cases of Ghosts and Demons

programme.title: Paranormal State: Beer, Wine and Spirits
programme.desc: Brian's bar has a cranky customer who's got a bad habit of breaking wine glasses. His name's Charlie, and he's been dead since prohibition.

programme.title: Paranormal State: The Fire
programme.desc: Christina has been experiencing paranormal activity ever since her father and step-mother were murdered near Columbus, OH last year.

programme.title: My Haunted House: The Hanover Haunting
programme.desc: For the first time, our cameras step inside an actively haunted house to hear two victims' terrifying testimony of paranormal activity.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The team meets with author David Domine to learn about the tragedy of Annie Whipple, a supposed “witch” who communicated with spirits to save the life of a child in her care.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 407
programme.desc: Dr. Martin Ellingham söker upp Louisa för att prata om hans nya jobb som kirurg i London. De avbryts av Bert som vill planera en babyshower för Louisa.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 408
programme.desc: Dr. Martin Ellingham och Pauline förvånas över antalet patienter som besöker mottagningen innan den stängs och han flyttar till London.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 501
programme.desc: Martin Ellinghams planer på att återuppta sin karriär som konsult i London avbryts i och med födseln av hans son som han fick tillsammans med den nu främmande Louisa Glasson.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 502
programme.desc: Efter Dr. Dibbs avfärd återvänder allmänläkaren till sin tidigare tjänst på mottagningen och går med på att stanna tills en ersättare har hittats.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 503
programme.desc: Den nya receptionisten, Morwenna Newcross, får en dålig start efter att ha kommit sent på sin första arbetsdag. Hennes hyperaktiva beteende får Martin att tro att hon är hög på droger.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 504
programme.desc: Louisas hippiemamma, Eleanor, kommer till byn och tar omedelbart över Martins kök för att göra en ört-tonic, som hon senare ger till barnet för att få honom att sluta gråta.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 505
programme.desc: PC Penhale blir chockad över att hans ex-fru, Maggie, plötsligt dyker upp och verkar ha glömt att de har separerat och vill nu veta varför han lämnade henne.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 506
programme.desc: Maggie får klartecken från doktorn och bestämmer sig för att återvända till Bude. PC Penhale tvingas vidta desperata metoder för att övertala henne att stanna i Portwenn.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 507
programme.desc: Bert Larges restaurang har ekonomiska problem. Han har inte ens råd till mat och dryck för ett välgörenhetsevent för att samla in pengar till Florence Dingles kattfristad.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 508
programme.desc: TIshell bestämmer sig för att hon inte kan dölja sin kärlek för Martin. Efter att hon druckit en drink, gjord på starka läkemedel, vidtar hon drastiska åtgärder.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 601
programme.desc: Portwenn är upptagen med förberedelserna för bröloppet mellan Doc och Louisa. Ruth har problem med att ta hand om James och så går strömmen.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 602
programme.desc: Louisa är tillbaka i skolan igen och deras nya dagmamma, Mel är sen till jobbet. När Mel till slut dyker upp blir Martin skeptisk till att lämna över deras barn till en som har svårt att passa tiden.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 603
programme.desc: En främling stannar upp när han ser Ruth, och spionerar sedan på henne när hon fikar med Caroline. Ruth är osäker på varför, men börjar känna sig obekväm.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 604
programme.desc: Louisa vill att Martin ska engagera sig mer med James, så hon låter honom ta James till deras lekgrupp där de måste para ihop sig med en mamma och hennes dotter för att sjunga sånger.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 605
programme.desc: Mrs Tishell återvänder till byn. Martin måste reda ut vad det är för fel på Lorna. Al och Morwenna råkar ut för ett onlinedejting-haveri och kärleken blomstrar mellan Bert och Jennifer.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 606
programme.desc: Hypokondrikern Malcom Rayner har problem med andningen och Martin frågar honom om han någonsin har jobbat nära asbest.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 607
programme.desc: Al får ett besök från två militärpoliser som letar efter James barnvakt, Mike Pruddy.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 608

programme.title: Wildfire: Fear
programme.desc: Kris must turn to Junior for help when she is asked to throw a race by John Zack, the figure from Pablo's past.

programme.title: Wildfire: Break Down

programme.title: Wildfire: 51/49

programme.title: Wildfire: Who Are You?
programme.desc: Kris must woo an influential heiress in hopes of getting Wildfire, and SVt Dani's horse Ishmael, selected for the Breeders Invitational Stakes.

programme.title: Wildfire: For Love Or Money?
programme.desc: Kris must choose between an opportunity to win a spot in the Breeders Invitational Stakes and caring for an in-labor Belladonna.

programme.title: Wildfire: Close Shave
programme.desc: Kris is reunited with Wildfire in time to race on the world's biggest stage, in the Breeders Invitational Stakes.

programme.title: Wildfire: Fairy Tale Endings

programme.title: Wildfire: The Feud
programme.desc: Kris resorts to desperate measures to ease Raintree's financial crisis.

programme.title: Wildfire: Moving On
programme.desc: Kris has a falling-out with Jean over Wildfire's readiness to race again.

programme.title: Wildfire: Close To Home

programme.title: Wildfire: Love Vs. Work

programme.title: Wildfire: Kiss Kiss
programme.desc: Kris is overcome by emotion when she helps Matt and Junior try to save Flame from being sold by Junior's dad.

programme.title: Wildfire: Push Me/Pull You
programme.desc: Kris worries about her status at Raintree after Gillian moves into the bunkhouse with Matt and begins offering unsolicited advice about Wildfire's training.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Good-Bye
programme.desc: With Raintree in dire financial straits, Jean and Matt's willingness to consider a buyer's offer draws criticism from Pablo and Kris.

programme.title: Wildfire: Heartless
programme.desc: Kris increasingly becomes the object of Matt's affection; this renders his relationship with Gillian incompatible.

programme.title: Wildfire: Diplomacy
programme.desc: Kris and Matt's rekindled relationship comes as a shock to Junior, who is distracted by consoling Dani in her time of mourning.

programme.title: Wildfire: You Can't Count On Me
programme.desc: Kris' endeavors to get accustomed to her new relationship with Matt and deal with Pablo's departure are interrupted by a surprise visit from her half brother (Ignacio Serricchio).

programme.title: Wildfire: Picking Sides
programme.desc: Kris tries to repair the rift between Matt and Junior, but the tension is exacerbated by the approach of the important Bristol Stakes and the return of Gillian, who proceeds to resume her bonding with Junior.

programme.title: Wildfire: So Long, Pardner
programme.desc: In the third-season finale, Kris and Matt weigh a generous offer from Sheik Omar that would go a long way toward easing Raintree's financial woes---but that also may be against the law.

programme.title: On the Case: Murder in Room 205
programme.desc: A young woman's journey to a new life comes to a savage end in a roadside motel.

programme.title: On the Case: Cry on My Shoulder
programme.desc: When a young woman disappears, police zero in on her violent ex-boyfriend. But the secret to solving the case is buried in a cold case file.

programme.title: On the Case: Last Rites
programme.desc: When a nun is found strangled and stabbed to death on the day before Easter, investigators are forced to look behind church walls in search of a killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Deadly Predator
programme.desc: A sexual predator viciously murders a 16 year old girl. Can investigators catch him before he kills again?

programme.title: On the Case: Tracks of a Killer
programme.desc: Police retrace a young woman's final movements with hope that it will lead them straight to her killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Mystery In The Desert
programme.desc: When an innocent couple is murdered execution style in the Arizona desert it marks the beginning of a 50 year search for the truth. Who really killed them and why? After decades of investigation the controversial case remains shrouded in mystery

programme.title: On the Case: Fatal Footage
programme.desc: An innocent mother of two is mysteriously shot in downtown Philadelphia. Surveillance cameras record every detail but can't unmask the killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Stabbed in the Heart
programme.desc: A beloved mother of four is stabbed to death in her bathroom. A mysterious v shaped wound on her forehead finally leads police to her killer decades later.

programme.title: On the Case: Shattered Hope
programme.desc: Nineteen-year-old Shelley Sikes vanishes one night after her shift, and then her abandoned, blood-streaked car is discovered on a dark roadway.

programme.title: On the Case: The Green Dragon
programme.desc: A four year old boy's terrifying discovery sends police on the hunt for a vicious killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Haunting Memories
programme.desc: Twenty-year-old college student Kim Montelaro goes missing from a mall parking lot, then her lifeless body is found in a ravine five miles from the mall; investigators piece together the timeline of Montelaro's last moments alive and crack the case.

programme.title: On the Case: Murder Ordained?
programme.desc: When a young minister's wife is found dead, it appears to be a tragic accident. But then, another member of the congregation is murdered. Police begin to wonder if its just a coincidence or a calculated plot.

programme.title: On the Case: The Answer Was No
programme.desc: Police try to retrace a young mother's last known movements in an attempt to solve her mysterious disappearance.

programme.title: On the Case: A Betrayal Concealed
programme.desc: A 17-year-old's shocking murder shatters the peace in a small town and destroys her family.

programme.title: On the Case: A Killer in Disguise
programme.desc: Police race to track down the unlikely killer responsible for three terrifying murders.

programme.title: On the Case: Predator on the Loose
programme.desc: A deadly predator haunts the city of Stockton, California and becomes more and more violent.

programme.title: On the Case: A Slip of Fate
programme.desc: A woman is found clinging to the guardrail of a steep embankment. She tells police a harrowing story; two men had attacked her and her husband at gunpoint and now he is missing. Was it a robbery gone wrong or part of a far more sinister plot?

programme.title: On the Case: Desperate Cry
programme.desc: A mother's desperate cry for help alerts neighbors and leads to a terrifying discovery.

programme.title: On the Case: Unanswered Questions
programme.desc: Patti Berry disappears on the way to pick up her child at the babysitter's, then her body is found in a secluded wooded area not far from her abandoned blood-soaked car.

programme.title: On the Case: Screams for Justice
programme.desc: The eyewitness accounts of neighbors may help or hinder investigators as they seek to solve the murder of a young woman.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Big Plans, Bad Luck
programme.desc: Mikey decides to get Buffalo involved in a D-Day paratrooper jump to commemorate the 70th anniversary of D-Day. Prefkar escapes Hay River courier duty. Cory finds an original bracket for the DC3 static line for Mikey's D-Day jump.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Dogfight
programme.desc: Buffalo's top guns, rookies and vets, go to California for aerial dogfights in real fighter planes. Cory and Mikey race to get ready for the D-Day jump.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: D-Day
programme.desc: Mikey's much-planned D-Day tribute parachute jump with 20 paratroopers hits a wall when Joe refuses to fly his DC-3 to the drop zone.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: 40/40/40
programme.desc: Rookie co-pilot Scott faces his worst nightmare when a faltering Curtiss C-46 Commando engine and low fog force a scary landing.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Pre-Christmas Rush
programme.desc: Christmas is just around the corner, but Buffalo's crucial food and mail runs come to a halt. An engine seizure strands Scott, AJ and the C-46 plane, creating a chaotic chain reaction.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Birthday from Hell
programme.desc: A string of bad luck turns chief pilot Arnie's 66th birthday run into the flight from hell - and threatens to spoil his naughty birthday surprise.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: A Big Deal
programme.desc: When a power failure leaves Rankin Inlet exposed to the brutal northern elements, captain Justin races to deliver an emergency generator. Ramp hand Jeremy tries to move ahead of co-worker Audrey by training a new hire from India to replace him.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: 40/40/40
programme.desc: Mechanic Cory races against the clock to turn two short-haul waterbombers into transatlantic aircraft for the epic journey to Turkey. It's up to engineer Adam to get the C-46 crew out of a jam on a remote airstrip in minus 40.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: On the Move
programme.desc: A charter flight falls through the cracks after the McBryans attend a wild family wedding, and an irate Joe pulls captain Justin from the Turkey test flights to do the job.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Suspension
programme.desc: A furious Joe fights against a federal suspension that will prevent him from carrying passengers for the first time in 20 years. It's also a setback for Jeremy and the other rampies, which takes a turn for the worse with an unexpected injury.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Cause for Celebration
programme.desc: AJ and Candace get married in the Ice Castle. A frustrated Chuck tries to get the Electra to pay her way. A flummoxed Mikey tries to bake a cake for Joe's birthday.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Transatlantic Crossing
programme.desc: The Turkey crew makes the critical jump over the North Atlantic. But en route to Portugal, one crew is forced to turn back.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Thin Ice
programme.desc: C-46 and DC-4 crews race against the spring melt to fly mining equipment to an airstrip on a frozen lake. Jeremy tries to catch up to fellow rampies Audrey and Wilf.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: The Crash
programme.desc: After thousands of hours of painstaking preparation and dangerous flying, a terrible accident devastates the waterbomber crew in Turkey - and everyone at Buffalo.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Change of Seasons
programme.desc: When her husband quits after a blowout with Joe, Kelly is put in a terrible position. Will she stay at Buffalo - or will she go? Scott gets the news he must stand down from flying so another co-pilot can fast-track to captain.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Up In the Air
programme.desc: After her husband's acrimonious departure from Buffalo, Kelly has a confrontation that decides whether she, too, will quit. Jeremy makes a mistake that could end his Buffalo career.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Frozen Four
programme.desc: As Joe fights a Transport Canada claim against the airline, star pilot Justin is tasked with shipping an 8,000lb generator to a remote town. But a controversial decision results in the DC-4 becoming stranded and frozen solid on a High Arctic airstrip.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Fire and Ice
programme.desc: When a deadly fire destroys a northern outpost a week before Christmas, Buffalo puts everything aside to come to the rescue. Cargo Manager Kelly receives a shocking diagnosis that renews her fight to quit smoking.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Under Pressure
programme.desc: The curse of -40 hits Buffalo pilots Devan and Scott on a food mail flight up the Mackenzie Valley when a mysterious rise in oil pressure threatens to destroy one of the C-46's engines.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Cold Hard Cash
programme.desc: Ton and Allen go North to Alaska and get a cold reception from the local auctioneer. They find two enormous seaplane pontoons and a pair of Smith & Wesson revolvers, including the most powerful production handgun in the world!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hot Wheels
programme.desc: '70s sand rail dune racer with rally hemi heads; 1965 replica Mustang pool table; off-road racing gear.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Driller Instinct
programme.desc: Ton & Allen encounter aggressive outdoorsmen in the Alaskan wilderness. The guys discover an 8-wheeled ATV that travels on both land & water and an air percussion hammer that can drill through solid rock!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Ruff Day

programme.desc: An elderly admirer courts Fran.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Something Larry This Way Comes
programme.desc: Al goes out of his way to help Kelly and meet his TV idol, Larry Storch.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Get The Dodge Out Of Hell
programme.desc: Al's Dodge goes into the car wash, but doesn't come out.
programme.sub-title: Get The Dodge Out Of Hell

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Thinergy
programme.desc: Marcy introduces Peg to a new energetic diet to improve her marriage. Al, meanwhile, wants to part of it but learns if he tries the diet, he can persuade Peg to quit. He must then swallow his pride and admit to Peggy he loves her no matter what.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Sixteen Years & What Do You Get
programme.desc: It's the Bundy’s 16th wedding anniversary. Al plans to buy Peggy a very fancy watch, but unfortunately, his credit card gets declined. Dare he show up at the party without a present?
programme.sub-title: Sixteen Years & What Do You Get

programme.title: Våra värsta år: But I Didn't Shoot the Deputy
programme.desc: There has been a rash of burglaries in the area, and the Rhodes' house is robbed and Al's car stereo is ripped off. Steve and Marcy buy a guard dog that won't stop barking, and Al purchases a fire arm. Ultimately, the two methods of home defense clash.
programme.sub-title: But I Didn't Shoot the Deputy

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Have You Driven a Ford Lately
programme.desc: Al and Steve buy a beat up Ford Mustang off of one of Kelly's boyfriends. Soon they form a tight friendship while fixing it up like new. The only problem is they are neglecting their wives.
programme.sub-title: Have You Driven a Ford Lately

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Whose Room Is It Anyway
programme.desc: Steve and Marcy plan to add a new room onto their house using their tax refund money. Al convinces Steve to make it into a billiards room while Peggy convinces Marcy to make it into an exercise room.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Al Loses His Cherry
programme.desc: Al gets a first-hand look at swinging bachelor life when he takes refuge at Luke's apartment after an argument with Peggy over visiting her relatives for the weekend.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Peggy Sue Got Work
programme.desc: To get the money to purchase a new VCR that Al won't buy her, Peggy takes a job in a department store selling clocks.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Married Without Children
programme.desc: When Al and Peg decide to go on vacation, Steve and Marcy volunteer to take care of their kids, Bud and Kelly. But, their enthusiasm changes when the kids throw a huge party at the Rhoades' house.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Poker Game
programme.desc: Al invites Steve to play poker with his friends, but ends up losing his paycheck to Al. Avoiding telling the truth to Marcy fails as Al plans to use his winnings to buy a fishing rod. Ultimately, Marcy enlists the help of Peggy to stop him.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Where's the Boss
programme.desc: When the owner of the shoe store is in a near-fatal plane crash, Al decides that it is time to get some recognition from his boss or quit his job. After quitting, Al returns to the shoe store, but not without a surprise.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Nightmare on Al's Street
programme.desc: Marcy freaks out when she begins having erotic dreams about Al after a heated argument about men vs women, and wonders whether she is actually sexually attracted to Al. Haunted by her dreams, Marcy ultimately comes to a conclusion and confronts Al.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Johnny B. Gone
programme.desc: Al and Peggy delay going to a closing of their favorite hamburger joint, Johnny Be Good's, when Bud and Kelly need them to solve their own problems. Meanwhile, Steve and Marcy prepare a party for their bosses at home.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Buck Can Do It
programme.desc: Al is reluctant to have Buck neutered despite being threatened with lawsuits from numerous neighbors regarding Buck's "nocturnal carnal activities.”

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Poppy's By The Tree - Pt 1
programme.desc: The Bundys take a vacation to near-beautiful Dumpwater, Florida and stay in a cut-rate motel where an ax murderer that hates tourists shows up every five years since 1967.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Poppy's By The Tree - Pt 2
programme.desc: After a hair-raising encounter with the maniac, Al decides to get the family out of town. But, they are trapped at the motel by a storm and the locals are unwilling to help them.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: If I Were a Rich Man
programme.desc: Steve takes Al to the vault at the bank where Steve works for a secret after-hours card game. The next day, one million dollars is reported missing.
programme.sub-title: If I Were a Rich Man

programme.title: Våra värsta år: For Whom the Bell Tolls
programme.desc: Al gets heated up over the large phone bill and refuses to pay it. This results in the disconnection of the Bundy phone line and making him the target of hostility from Peggy, the kids and the Rhodes who now take the Bundys phone calls on their phone.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Girls Just Wanna Have Fun - Pt 1
programme.desc: While Al and Steve are occupied by a female employee who fixes the Bundy's refrigerator, Peggy invites Marcy to a strip club with the girls.
programme.sub-title: Girls Just Wanna Have Fun - Pt 1

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Girls Just Wanna Have Fun - Pt 2
programme.desc: Marcy loses her composure and wedding ring when it slips into a dancer's briefs while slipping him a tip. Desperate to keep the news from Steve, Marcy sets out to distract him every chance she gets.
programme.sub-title: Girls Just Wanna Have Fun - Pt 2

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Born to Walk
programme.desc: Al flunks his written drivers test the same day that Kelly passes hers, leading him confined to the house and unable to get to the racetrack to bet on an important horse race.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Alley of the Dolls
programme.desc: Victory seems assured when Steve agrees to join the Bundys for a family team bowling match against Peggy's arch rival from high school, Mimi, and her obnoxious family.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Razor's Edge
programme.desc: Steve returns home having grown a beard from a week-long rafting trip. He and Marcy get into a huge argument over his reluctance to shave it off, leading him to move in with the Bundys.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: How do You Spell Revenge?
programme.desc: Al, Peggy and Bud are part of a shopping mall softball team playing other mall teams. After losing a few too many games, Al demands that Peggy improve her softball skills or she is off his team.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Earth Angel
programme.desc: There's a new light in the neighborhood when Bud brings home an attractive, free spirited, 21-year-old artist named Tiffany on her way to art school in New York. Everyone likes her, except Marcy, who thinks Tiffany steals the attentions of Steve.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: You Better Watch Out
programme.desc: The Bundys' Christmas is rudely interrupted when a parachuting mall Santa crash-lands into their backyard, attracting the neighborhood kids.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Guys and Dolls
programme.desc: When starting a baseball card collection, Al and Steve sell Marcy's old Barbie doll. They must get it back, but learn that the shop they sold it to was robbed.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Build a Better Mousetrap
programme.desc: Al's attempts to get rid of a rodent in the Bundy house end badly.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Master the Possibilities
programme.desc: Al, under the impression that you don't have to pay for anything you didn't order, takes Peggy and Bud on a wild spending spree when the mailman accidentally leaves a new credit card addressed to Buck the dog.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Blonde and Blonder
programme.desc: On Valentines Day, Kelly hauls in a load of Valentines, while Steve plans to give Marcy a trip to Hawaii. When Marcy finds out from Peggy, she plans to give Steve his Valentine present by jumping out of a life-size cake.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Great Escape
programme.desc: The Bundy's stay at the shoe store after their house is tented for termites. A grounded Kelly plots to escape and go to a rock concert.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Impo-Dent
programme.desc: Marcy regrets denting Steve's new car when he claims that she's made him impotent.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Just Married…with Children
programme.desc: While secretly going through Steve and Marcy's mail, Al and Peggy fill out an application to a TV game show called "How Do I Love Thee" where the objective is a Bundy natural: surviving physical torture from one's spouse.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Father Lode
programme.desc: After going with Steve to the racetrack, Al is reluctant to reveal that he won $1,200, because he knows that Peggy and the kids will take the money for themselves.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: All in the Family
programme.desc: Al's quiet three-day weekend plans to watch his favorite John Wayne movie "Hondo" are ruined when Peggy's eccentric relatives come to visit the Bundy household.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Camping Show (aka A Period Piece)
programme.desc: Steve, Marcy and the Bundys head out to Steve and Marcy's cabin in the woods, but the merriment is halted by Kelly's PMS. The men leave for a bit to go out fishing, and return to all three women menstruating and hostile.
programme.sub-title: The Camping Show (aka A Period Piece)

programme.title: Våra värsta år: He Thought He Could
programme.desc: Al discovers a library book that was due in 1957. He must return it to the library and face up to his worst childhood fear: the librarian.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Butterfly
programme.desc: The IMF attempts to clear an American businessman in Japan of false charges that he murdered his Japanese wife in "Butterfly," a segment of Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible" series.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Contender, Pt. 1

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Contender, Pt. 2

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Execution

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Play

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Cardinal

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Elixir
programme.desc: The Impossible Missions Force offers a "fountain of youth" to the vain and dictatorial widow (guest star Ruth Roman) of the late president of a small South American country in order to depose her.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Exchange
programme.desc: Cinnamon is captured and the enemy discovers the one thing that would unmask her identity and expose the Impossible Mission Force.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Bargain

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Mind of Stefan Miklos

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Freeze

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Test Case

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The System

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Glass Cage

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Live Bait

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Doomsday
programme.desc: When an unscrupulous manufacturer risks World War III by offering a hydrogen bomb for sale, the Impossible Missions Force enters the bidding with a dangerous plan to keep the weapon out of enemy hands.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Bunker, Pt. 1
programme.desc: The IMF races a paid killer who is stalking a nuclear scientist forced by the enemy to work on a device that could upset the world power balance in the first of a two-part episode.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Bunker, Pt. 2
programme.desc: While trying to free a nuclear scientist and his wife from enemy hands, the IMF is trapped when a would-be assassin takes over one of Rollin's disguises in Part 2.

programme.title: The Cooler

programme.title: The History of Love
programme.desc: Det var en gång en pojke som hette Leo som älskade en flicka som hette Alma. Leo lovade Alma att han skulle få henne att skratta hela livet. Men så kom kriget och skilde dem åt.

programme.title: About Us
programme.desc: Ett par vill väcka liv i kärleken och åker tillbaka till platsen där de tillbringade sin smekmånad åtta år tidigare. De kämpar tillsammans för att nå varandra igen. Allt kulminerar i en hjärtskärande final när dolda sanningar kommer upp i ljuset.

programme.title: Life Itself
programme.desc: Oscar Isaac, Olivia Cooke och Antonio Banderas är bara några av stjärnorna i dramat Life Itself. Där samma händelse kommer påverka många människors liv. Vi får följa dem över årtionden, från gatorna i New York till den spanska landsbygden.

programme.title: What If

programme.title: The Necessary Death of Charlie Countryman

programme.title: The Lunchbox

programme.title: All for Her

programme.title: The Rules of Attraction

programme.title: The Dead Zone: Double Vision

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Midnight Sun

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Odyssey of Flight 33

programme.title: The Dead Zone: Ascent

programme.title: The Dead Zone: Destiny

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Four O'Clock

programme.title: The Dead Zone: Netherworld

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Where is Everybody?

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Spur of the Moment

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Mighty Casey

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Lateness of the Hour
programme.desc: The daughter of an inventor objects to their 'perfect' home where they are waited on by mechanical servants.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity: Next of Kin

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 2
programme.desc: När ett par välkomnar en nyfödd bebis i sitt hem börjar en demonisk närvaro att terrorisera dem och göra deras perfekta värld till en oundviklig mardröm.

programme.title: MacGyver: Gauntlet

programme.title: MacGyver: Golden Triangle

programme.title: MacGyver: Trumbo's World

programme.title: MacGyver: Hellfire

programme.title: MacGyver: The Prodigal

programme.title: MacGyver: Death Lock

programme.title: Scorpion SV: Extinction

programme.desc: Team Scorpion fortsätter att arbeta med sin nemesis, Mark Collins, för att förhindra en utrotning som skulle kunna göra slut på mänskligheten.

programme.sub-title: Grow a Deer, A Female Deer

programme.title: Scorpion SV: Nuke Kids on the Block

programme.title: Scorpion SV: Sci Hard
programme.desc: Under en tech-konferens tas Team Scorpion som gisslan av en grupp som försöker genomföra en virtuell stöld.

programme.title: Scorpion SV: Go with the Flo(rence)
programme.desc: Medan Walter spårar en anordning som kan förhindra en kärnvapenkollaps genom Los Angeles kloaker lär han sig hur man lyssnar på Paige och hur man inte ger henne råd.

programme.title: Scorpion SV: Faire Is Foul
programme.desc: På Sylvesters födelsedag besöker team Scorpion en renässansfestival, men festligheterna avbryts när en grupp försöker råna ett närliggande bevisförvaringsskåp hos polisen.

programme.title: Scorpion SV: It's Raining Men (of War)
programme.desc: På Thanksgiving följer team Scorpions nya granne Florence med till sjöss på ett uppdrag att förstöra en flytande ö bestående av skräp.

programme.title: Scorpion SV: Crime Every Mountain
programme.desc: Medan Cabes rättegång hotar Team Scorpion, går ett enkelt fall i stöpet när de hjälper en far och hans dotter vars flygplan kraschat i närheten.

programme.title: Scorpion SV: Who Let the Dog Out ('Cause Now It's Stuck in a Cistern)
programme.desc: Medan Team Scorpion ivrigt väntar på domen i Cabes rättegång, som kan skicka honom i fängelse, koncentrerar de sin nervösa energi på att försöka rädda en hund som sitter fast i en cistern.
programme.sub-title: Who Let the Dog Out ('Cause Now It's Stuck in a Cistern)

programme.title: Scorpion SV: A Christmas Car-Roll
programme.desc: På julafton, när Walter väljer att arbeta istället för att umgås med sina vänner, faller han ner för trappan och slår i huvudet. När han ligger medvetslös går han in i en drömvärld där Team Scorpion aldrig har existerat.

programme.title: Scorpion SV: The Bunker Games
programme.desc: Team Scorpion måste samarbeta med Tobys nemesis, Quincy Berkstead, och hans fru Amy, Tobys före detta fästmö, när de är inlåsta i en artificiellt intelligent domedagsbunker som syftar till att döda dem.

programme.title: Scorpion SV: Lighthouse of the Rising Sun
programme.desc: En solstorm slår ut strömmen i Los Angeles och Team Scorpion måste hjälpa en tonårspilot och hans flickvän som är vilse över Stilla havet utan navigering eller radiokontakt.

programme.title: Scorpion SV: Wave Goodbye
programme.desc: Team Scorpion måste förhindra att en inkommande tsunami träffar en sårbar kärnkraftsanläggning, och Toby hjälper i hemlighet sin före detta fästmö att återfå sin stulna identitet.

programme.title: Scorpion SV: Nerd, Wind & Fire

programme.title: Scorpion SV: Dumbster Fire
programme.desc: Genierna i Team Scorpion förvandlas till knäppgökar och Paige måste förenkla vetenskapen för dem när deras mentala förmågor försämras under ett jobb för att förhindra skapandet av ett svart hål.

programme.title: Scorpion SV: Dork Day Afternoon
programme.desc: Team Scorpion hamnar oavsiktligt i ett pågående bankrån och tas som gisslan. Dessutom växer Sylvesters känslor för Florence.

programme.title: Scorpion SV: Gator Done
programme.desc: Team Scorpion beger sig till Bayou för att spåra upp en listig alligator för att stoppa ett dödligt myggburet virus, och Paige lär Walter begreppet "vit lögn".

programme.title: Scorpion SV: Foul Balls
programme.desc: Team Scorpion måste använda deras höga IQ för att vinna en softballmatch när chefen utmanar dem, med alla deras framtida regeringskontrakt på spel.

programme.title: Scorpion SV: Kenny and the Jet
programme.desc: Paiges moderliga sida går upp i hög växel när Team Scorpion måste rädda en medvetslös, nedkyld pojke som sitter fast i hjulhuset på deras flygande flygplan.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 101
programme.desc: Värd Lisbeth Østergaard och de två experterna besöker Maiken och Michael i deras lilla lägenhet där de bor tillsammans med Michaels dotter. Snart blir de fyra och kan inte längre bo i lägenheten.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 102
programme.desc: Vi besöker Jannie och René i deras lägenhet i centrala Esbjerg. Deras ettåriga dotter Alba sover i föräldrarnas sovrum och har inga utsikter att få ett eget rum.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 103
programme.desc: Vi besöker Sabine och Jakob i deras lägenhet i Valby. Deras dotter Solveig har ett rum i en 4 m2 stor studio, så familjen vill desperat flytta till något större.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 104
programme.desc: Sonja och Emil bor tillsammans med deras ettåriga son Vilmer. De har själva renoverat lägenheten helt och hållet och det har varit så svårt att de inte orkar med en ny renovering.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 105
programme.desc: Charlotte och Martin får besök av Lisbeth Østergaard och de två experterna i deras lägenhet. Charlotte har flyttat in i Martins lägenhet, men drömmer om att börja om på nytt och flytta in i ett hus.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 201
programme.desc: Camilla Ottesen, fastighetsmäklaren Tobias Edlev Nielsen och arkitekten Mads Kappel Mikkelsen besöker Ida och Aske på Østerbro. De har letat efter en bostad i ett år, men har inte hittat drömhemmet.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 202
programme.desc: Fastighetsmäklaren Tobias och arkitekten Mads får en svår uppgift när det gäller att hitta ett hus åt Lea och Sebastian från Brønshøj.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 203
programme.desc: Vi besöker Camilla och Frederik i Frederiksberg, som är i desperat behov av hjälp, eftersom lägenheten paret bor i kommer snart att säljas. De vill också bo närmare grönområden.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 204
programme.desc: Pernille och Søren har en brinnande önskan om att flytta tillbaka till Horsens, där båda har vuxit upp. De har redan sålt lägenheten, så Tobias har bråttom att hitta ett hus åt paret.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 205
programme.desc: Det unga paret Molly och Morten vill ta steget och flytta från sin mycket lilla lägenhet i Köpenhamn till Silkeborg, där Mortens föräldrar bor i närheten.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 301
programme.desc: Astrid och Steffen ska köpa sitt första hus, men de kan inte kompromissa med sina önskemål. De träffar programmets experter som köper ett hus för deras räkning.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 302
programme.desc: Louise och Michael har vuxit ut ur sin lilla lägenhet i Århus och behöver mer utrymme. Paret gör en kompromiss och Louise möter sin största mardröm i huset som experterna köper åt dem.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 303
programme.desc: Charlotte och Mikkel bor i en så liten lägenhet att duschen måste tömmas på saker varje gång de ska använda den. Men nu vill de flytta från staden med deras son.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 304
programme.desc: Pernille och Nicklas från Odense lever så litet att om de behöver lite privatliv har de bara toaletten att gå till. Nicklas drömmer om att ha ett kök med två ugnar så att han kan laga mer mat.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 305
programme.desc: Wendy och Jesper från Kalundborg bor redan bra, i en lägenhet som har en otrolig utsikt. Men en kommande familjeökning innebär att de måste hitta något större.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 306
programme.desc: Jonas och Louise blir chockade när de ser vilka hus de har råd med. Mads Mikkelsen och Tobias Edlev Nielsen arbetar övertid för att försöka uppfylla parets önskemål.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 307
programme.desc: Mads och Mia vill flytta lite utanför staden - men inte helt ute på landet. Med Tobias och Mads hjälp, köper de ett hem som har exakt allt de inte gillar.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 401
programme.desc: I det första avsnittet möter vi Tine och Lars, som har svindlande åtta miljoner för att köpa ett hus och renovera. Men budgeten har inte hjälpt dem hittills - kan experterna vara till hjälp?

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 402
programme.desc: Experterna åker till Hørning, där en präst och hennes familj behöver ett nytt hem. Idag hyr de ett litet radhus och nu vill de flytta.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Jutland
programme.desc: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. Tareq visits a salt maker using medieval techniques and experiences the magic light of Skagen.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: East Denmark
programme.desc: East Denmark contains some of Denmark’s most fertile lands, and many traditional farmers are converting to organic production and winning awards for their cheeses and wine. Tareq bikes through an area of limestone cliffs and Viking ships.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kristianstad
programme.desc: Located in Sweden’s south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment. Tareq makes his own chocolate and learns all about the art of eel-fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Southwest Jutland
programme.desc: Tareq visits Sydvestjylland – a unique area in Denmark filled with endless contrasts. Many food innovators are using the surrounding environment to take old traditions and apply them to the 21st century.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Nynäshamn
programme.desc: Sunny Nynäshamn is a resort town close to Stockholm, but there is more here than the sea. Tareq meets a prize-winning chocolate maker using ingredients from her garden, visits a thriving local food market, and gets a lesson in how to smoke fish.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Røros
programme.desc: Born as a mining town in the 17th century, Røros is now a center for local and organic food producers. Tareq tries dairy products which Michelin-starred chefs swear by, goes skiing and sledding around Røros many hilly streets

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Vimmerby
programme.desc: Vimmerby is known as the birthplace of beloved author Astrid Lindgren. Tareq finds that the area is also well-regarded for its cuisine. From the children’s theme park to the friendly moose that roam the hills, Vimmerby has a lot to offer visitors.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Trysil
programme.desc: The mountains and snowfall in Trysil mean that the town has to be creative with food; Tareq learns how to make cheese in the traditional way, and goes skiing of course, and takes to the slopes to cook something as skiers pass by.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Värmland
programme.desc: Värmland is home to many of Sweden’s most famous authors and inventors. However, it is also a place with a rich food culture. Tareq gets his hands on a very rare bird to cook and also takes time out to float down a tranquil river on a wooden raft.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Fyn
programme.desc: Tareq visits Fyn, the fairy tale capital of the world. Famous as the birthplace of Hans Christian Andersen, Fyn is also known as the garden of Denmark. Here we explore stunning nature and world class cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höga Kusten
programme.desc: Created thousands of years ago, the High Coast in the northern part of Sweden is the highest coast in the world. Tareq sets out to sample one of the most extreme types of Swedish food, fermented herring.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Denmark
programme.desc: North Jutland has a rich culinary history. The unique conditions have created equally unique products. Tareq meets local food entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever changing environment and putting this region on the culinary map.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Uppsala
programme.desc: Uppsala is the city of knowledge: home to the oldest university in Scandinavia. It’s a wonderful agricultural area surrounded by fertile flatlands. Tareq discovers the historical treasures of Uppsala and its thriving culinary life.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Sealand
programme.desc: North Zealand has been a playground of the rich and famous since the fifteenth century. Tareq learns how this beautiful north eastern part of Denmark is the perfect place to go foraging for wild berries and herbs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åre
programme.desc: Sweden’s largest ski resort Åre is well known for its local ingredients, boasting the highest number of organic food producers per capita in Sweden. The fresh water and clean air create unique conditions for growing excellent food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Danish Lakelands
programme.desc: The Danish Lakelands produce some of the finest ingredients that you can find. Tareq has a go at an old cooking technique from New Zealand called Hangi - using heated rocks buried in a pit oven.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Gothenburg on the west coast of Sweden has recently been discovered as an exciting destination by both international travel journalists and food bloggers. Tareq tracks down an old army barracks which has been converted into a world class cheese factory.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Luleå
programme.desc: Tareq visits Luleå, home to the beautiful Tree Hotel: a collection of treehouses built by an award winning architect. Following the river further up into the mountains he reaches the land where, for centuries, the Sami people kept their reindeer herds.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Halmstad
programme.desc: In Halmstad Tareq explores the contrast between the busy summer scene at the beach and the quiet rural country life, meeting Jörgen Persson: award winning table tennis player and visiting a village famous for its cheese.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kemi
programme.desc: Kemi is situated in northern Finland by the Bothnian Bay and it is part of Lapland region. Tareq tries his luck at a spot of burbot fishing on the frozen sea and visits the snow castle hotel.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Situated on the west coast of Sweden, Bohuslän is a place where you can really feel the history of fishing all around a tradition that is still active. Tareq will be harvesting supreme quality oysters and lobsters and cook some wonderful seafood dishes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Florø
programme.desc: Tareq visits Norway and Florø to celebrate their national day -17th of May. Surrounded by breathtaking archipelagos and stunning fjords he dives for scallops in the north sea, cooking at mountain peaks and exploring the history of norwegian salmon

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Estonia
programme.desc: Tareq makes his way across the baltic sea to Estonia and the capital Tallinn. He discovers the historical treasures of the city and its thriving culinary life before he heads out into the vast and beautiful countryside and the national park of Soomaa.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Ringkøbing
programme.desc: Ringkøbing, a lovely old market town located at the west coast of Denmark. Here, Tareq visit a traditional Herring Festival and meets up with local entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever-changing environment.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Falkenberg
programme.desc: Something is definitely happening in Falkenberg on the west coast of Sweden. Over the last couple of years it have become somewhat of a haven for foodies. Tareq is on a mission; taking him through a fertile landscape with vineyards and salmon fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Estonia (Part 2)
programme.desc: Estonia has embarked on a journey greatly inspired by the nordic cuisine. Tareq explores the countryside of Estonia before he returns to the capital of Tallinn where he meets people that really love their traditional food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Öland
programme.desc: Tareq bikes through the unique landscape of Öland, Sweden's second largest island located in the Baltic Sea. It is a place where the interaction between man and nature have created a diverse and rich farmland with an amazing amount of small producers.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Bornholm, the sunny bright green island with it’s own gastronomic tone is a true pioneer when it comes to local food at it’s finest quality. Tareq visit Denmark's first regional food culture house where they develop this unique flourishing cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Laponia
programme.desc: In the northern part of Sweden, you’ll find the stunning world heritage Laponia. Almost 10.000 square kilometres of nature reserves and national parks. Tareq visit the rich, unique culture of the sami in the vast impressive wilderness.

programme.desc: Kirks triumf över Khan och skapandet av Genesisplaneten är tomma segrar. Spock är död och McCoy blir driven till vansinne. Ett besök av Sarek, Spocks far, avslöjar något chockerande: Spocks livsessens finns i McCoy.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Strange Hanging - Chantal Ternik Case
programme.desc: On April 3th 2003, Chantal Ternik, a 48 year old housewife, is discovered hanged in her house of Sanary-sur-Mer, in Var.
programme.sub-title: A Strange Hanging - Chantal Ternik Case

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: A Very Strange Suicide (Muller case)
programme.desc: Police in Strasbourg receive a startling emergency call from Doctor Jean-Louis Muller, a forensic pathologist well known in the region.
programme.sub-title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Very Strange Suicide (Muller case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Françoise Desnoue Case
programme.desc: On the evening of August 30st 2013, in a small village of Bougrogne, Éric Desnoue, 52 years old, reports his wife missing to the police. Did Françoise Desnoue run away? Or did she reattempt to kill herself?

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Sylvie Darcy Case
programme.desc: On February 26th 2012, in the Yevelines. Around 11PM policemen are called for an assault in a parking lot in the forest of Saint-Lambet-des-Bois.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Two Accused of Murder (Jennifer Charron Case)
programme.desc: On Sunday, April 29, 2007, the body of Jennifer Charron, 21-years old, was found burnt to a crisp in a forest near Royan. The young waitress, who had been missing for two days, was visibly beaten and tied up.
programme.sub-title: Two Accused of Murder (Jennifer Charron Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Josiane Bézard Case
programme.desc: On the morning of January 9th 2014, Josiane Bézard, 53 years old, drives her son to the Manosque's train station, and then vanishes.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Deadly Trap in the Forest - Christophe Belle
programme.desc: On March 19th 1998, Akira Ojima, a 57 years old japanese architect, is found dead in the fridge of a villa in Nanterre.
programme.sub-title: Deadly Trap in the Forest - Christophe Belle

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: (Ruth Légeret Case) Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake
programme.desc: On January 4, 2006, Ruth Légeret was found dead in the middle of a pool of blood at her luxurious property in Vevey, Switzerland. Next to her was the lifeless body of her friend, Marina Studer. Who could have killed these two simple and wealthy widows?
programme.sub-title: (Ruth Légeret Case) Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Mathilde Croguenne Case
programme.desc: In the early hours of the morning, Mathilde Croguennec, 18, attending \"Teknival\" in Brittany, is found at the foot of a tree with her throat cut. Investigators face the task of finding the killer among the 43,000 participants of this festival

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Laurence Dromard Case
programme.desc: Sylvain Dromard finds the body of his wife Laurence lying in a pool of blood in the kitchen. The crime was particularly violent and the theory of a burglary that went wrong is soon excluded. But investigators don't understand who could want her dead.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Shot In the While Sleeping (Richard Alessandri Case)
programme.desc: On the night of July 16, 2000, the life of Edwige Alessandri changed forever. She made a frantic emergency call in the town of Carpentras. She recounted that some men burst into her room and shot her husband while he slept.
programme.sub-title: Shot In the While Sleeping (Richard Alessandri Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Murdered For a Fake Treasure - Troadec Case
programme.desc: On March 28th 2013, the burnt body of Anne Barbot, 38 years old, is discovered in a forest of Maine-et-Loire.
programme.sub-title: Murdered For a Fake Treasure - Troadec Case

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Dire Deception (Laurence Maille Case)
programme.desc: On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Christophe Lejard Case
programme.desc: The lifeless body of Christophe Lejard is found by his son just metres from their home. The man was shot in the head as he was getting into his car to go to work. An execution, which at first glance doesn't square with the profile of a quiet family man.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Mystery of Room 602 (Ve´ronique Pirotton Case)
programme.desc: On October 31, 2013, Belgian politician Bernard Ouessfal rushed down the six flights of a hotel in Ostend where he had met up with his wife, Véronique, the day before. He had found her unconscious in the bathroom with a mysterious plastic bag next to her
programme.sub-title: The Mystery of Room 602 (Ve´ronique Pirotton Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Honeymoon Killers (Van Beers Case)
programme.desc: Marc Van Beers, a 36-year old Brussels tax lawyer, dies in a road accident while on honeymoon. His wife Aurore is unharmed by the accident.
programme.sub-title: Crime Scene Solvers: Honeymoon Killers (Van Beers Case)

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 806
programme.desc: Tinas mardröm började 2015 när hon fick en tumör på näsan som fortsatte att växa. Hon måste genomgå strålbehandling för att få bort den, men tumören lämnar också ett hål som måste stängas.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 303
programme.desc: Vi möter Doris som har varit med om en våldsam busskrasch. Idag kämpar hon med extrema konsekvenser av den plastikoperation som skulle rädda hennes utseende efter olyckan.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 101
programme.desc: Två av Danmarks toppkirurger möter offer för misslyckad plastikkirurgi. Bland andra träffar vi Mille, som jagar drömmen om perfektion, och Joan, som tycker att hon har förlorat sin kvinnlighet.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 103
programme.desc: Ivanas liv hängde på en skör tråd under hennes plastikoperation som kostade ett astronomiskt belopp. Lotte döljer sin sönderopererade mage bakom tatueringar. Kan kirurgerna hjälpa dem

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 703
programme.desc: Den före detta burleskdansösen Grethe fick båda sina bröst bortopererade 2011 som en del av sin behandling för bröstcancer.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 312
programme.desc: Vi möter Angelina gjort bröstkirurgi 11 gånger. I sökandet efter drömbrösten reser hon till Miami, där hon lägger in 1500 ml i brösten och det slutar med att de blir så stora att de spricker.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 308
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet möter vi Britt, som är upprörd både över utseendet på hennes bröst och den smärta hon fått efter en mastektomi och drömmer om ett bröllop med fina bröst och utan smärta.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 306
programme.desc: Vi möter Jeanette som känner sig som en försökskanin efter en rad misslyckade operationer.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 705
programme.desc: Som 21-åring drömmer Simone om runda och fylliga bröst. Hon genomgår en bröstförstoring som slutar med en inflammation varpå hon gör flera omoperationer, innan hon säger stopp till kirurgen.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 406
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet möter vi Anita som vaknade upp med större bröst än vad hon hade kommit överens om med kirurgen och som nu känner sig som en miniversion av Linse Kessler.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 102
programme.desc: Två av landets bästa kirurger är redo att hjälpa människor som fått betala ett högt pris för sin jakt efter ungdom och skönhet. Ta reda på om dessa misslyckade operationer kan korrigeras.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 404
programme.desc: Vi möter Maria, som efter en bröstförstoring fick ett hål ända upp till implantatet, och Casper, som hela sitt liv har blivit mobbad på grund av sin näsa.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 901
programme.desc: Som tonåring var Melissa ledsen över sin killiga kropp och beslutade sig för att genomgå tre bröstförstoringsoperationer. Men nu är hon fast i ett smärthelvete som är på väg att göra henne morfinberoende.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 704
programme.desc: Iben drömmer om att vinna en Body Fitness-tävling för nybörjare, men hon känner att hennes bröst är i vägen. Oavsett hur mycket hon arbetar på sin kropp kan hon inte träna sina bröst.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 906
programme.desc: Mia tycker att hon efter flera operationer ser ut som någon med fyra bröst. Alice mage blir allt större och större och hon kämpar med magsyra, smärta och oönskad gråt. Kan läkarna hjälpa dem?

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 701
programme.desc: Efter en våldsam olycka där Dan faller från ett tak och landar på ansiktet genomgår han två operationer för att laga sin näsa.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 905
programme.desc: Melanie och Monas operationer hindrar dem från att vara intima med sin respektive partner. Karina fick uppgradera sina bröst till Barbiebröst, och nu sipprar det ut var från bröstvårtorna.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 904
programme.desc: Jeannes bröst hindrar henne från att leva ett normalt liv. Gitte skäms för sina ben och lägger ner mycket tid och energi på att dölja dem.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 105
programme.desc: Sabine hittade ett erbjudande på nätet, men fick betala dyrt för sin rabatterade plastikoperation. Helle har under årens lopp uthärdat sådan smärta att hon inte ens kan arbeta.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 802
programme.desc: För första gången i programmets historia har både mor och dotter hamnat i en plastikkirurgi-mardröm. Nu söker de tillsammans hjälp.
