programme.desc: Special Forces operate deep behind enemy lines with top-of-the-line weapons.Host Wil Willis tests the Sig Sauer P226, the preferred choice like the Mark 25 by Navy SEALs, against competitors like the H&K Compact Tactical.

programme.title: Secret War: Agent Garbo
programme.desc: Juan Pujol, MI6's WWII agent "Garbo," created a fictitious spy network in Lisbon, deceiving the Germans with crucial disinformation and influencing their strategies. After the war, MI6 protected him, and he lived in Venezuela until his death in 1988.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Slovenia: The Crow's Flight
programme.desc: Monty heads to Slovenia to retrace one of the most daring, yet unknown, mass escapes of Allied prisoners during the second world war, made possible only with the help of partisans and locals.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Preparing for War
programme.desc: Hitler unveils his military plans: annex Austria, seize the Sudetenland, and eventually invade Poland and the Soviet Union. By March 1938, Austria falls bloodlessly. By September 1939, he invades Poland, sparking World War Two.

programme.title: Mata Hari - The Beautiful Spy
programme.desc: Mata Hari. Dance, Seduction and Espionage. The enduring myth.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Nazis Outfought
programme.desc: By 1944, Hitler's image as a victorious leader is crumbling. He faces a bomb plot led by Stauffenberg and Tresckow, intending to kill him and overthrow the regime. Hitler survives the bombing, triggering a brutal reprisal against conspirators.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: End Game
programme.desc: In January 1945, Nazi Germany faces defeat as Allied armies close in. Hitler, aged 55 and in poor health, remains defiant in his Berlin bunker. On April 30th, 1945, Hitler commits suicide, and days later, Germany surrenders, ending World War II.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Traitor-in-Chief
programme.desc: Pierre Laval, once celebrated and later reviled, faced execution in 1945 for collaboration with the Nazis during Vichy France. Originally a socialist and pacifist, he fell into collaboration for power and to navigate the horrors of occupation.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The AK-47, the world's deadliest firearm, sparked a Cold War race for superior assault rifles like the American M4 and German HK 416. Host Wil Willis explores its history, from Mikhail Kalashnikov's WWII experiences to its assembly and lethal impact.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Becoming Respectable
programme.desc: In 1924, Hitler is convicted for High Treason after the failed Nazi power grab. In prison, he writes Mein Kampf, articulating his anti-Semitic and expansionist beliefs. Upon release, Hitler rebrands the Nazi Party.

programme.title: Hitler's Mega Plane: Hitler's Mega Plane
programme.desc: In January 2012, Italian divers discovered the wreck of a massive plane off the coast of Sardinia. At a depth of 65 meters (213 feet) lies a Messerschmidt “Gigant”.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Tanks have transformed warfare since their debut a century ago. Host Wil Willis traces their evolution from World War One breakthroughs to modern marvels like the M1 Abrams, the world's most powerful Main Battle Tank.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Devil's Due
programme.desc: During WWII, Greek Prime Ministers Tsolakoglou, Logothetopoulos, and Rallis collaborated with Nazi occupiers, imposing fees that caused a famine.

programme.title: Secret War: The Dutch Disaster
programme.desc: Operation North Pole was a WWII German deception using captured SOE agents to mislead Britain. 47 of 50 agents were captured. Despite warnings, SOE ignored signs of compromise to maintain support, leading to a major intelligence failure.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Former U.S. Army Ranger Wil Willis tests modern combat shotguns like the Benelli M4 and Mossberg 590, alongside historic models.This documentary features 3D animations and weapon tests to explore effectiveness of combat shotguns.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: Closing the Ring
programme.desc: The Western Allies secure supply routes that will allow them to enter Germany, and the Ardennes counter-offensive fails. The Red Army advances rapidly. The SS implements the Holocaust.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Today’s infantry demands a weapon combining machine gun firepower with rifle accuracy and mobility.. Host Wil Willis traces this journey through iconic firearms.

programme.title: My Haunted House: Dream House and Ghost Month
programme.desc: A woman's recurring nightmare comes to life in her new house. A single mother fears for her son's life after moving into a new house.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Joanna Cassidy
programme.desc: Actress Joanna Cassidy (Blade Runner, Six Feet Under) seeks out the help of psychic medium Kim Russo to find out who has been haunting her 1800s-era home in Natchitoches, LA.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Anthony Michael Hall
programme.desc: Actor Anthony Michael Hall (The Breakfast Club, Sixteen Candles, The Dead Zone) seeks the help of medium Kim Russo.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Orlando Jones
programme.desc: Comedian and actor, Orlando Jones (Sleepy Hollow) revisits the North Carolina hotel where he had a paranormal experience so frightening that it forced him to flee in the middle of the night.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Margaret Cho
programme.desc: Comedienne and actress, Margaret Cho (Drop Dead Diva) returns to the house in Peachtree, Georgia where she experienced such a terrifying and violent energy that the memory continues to haunt her today.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Lauded as “The Mecca of Paranormal Investigation”, Waverly Hills is purportedly home to spirits who are not shy to interact with visitors who frequent its massive halls, with decades’ worth of inexplicable finds documented by various investigators.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: One of Tennessee''s most respected thoroughbred horse farms, the Rose Mont was built by Judge "Jo" Conn Guild, where his family resided for generations. Today, it operates as a wedding and event venue where guests have claimed to spot apparitions.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Tennessee's first maximum security prison was a glorified slave labor camp that treated inmates as single use units of labor. Miners were left to die during cave-ins, and the facility was known as "the end of the line."

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Owned and operated by the same caretakers of Old South Pittsburg Hospital, Harriman presents a unique opportunity for the team to delve further into the study of hospital phenomena.

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Chocolate Factory
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Hull to investigate ghostly goings on inside of a former chocolate factory. The investigation turns out to be no picnic, as the ghosts haunting make direct contact with the team.

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Haunted Parade
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Hoylake and investigate a building known as The Parade. Dating back to 1909, this once former school, still seems to have ghostly pupils and teachers taking class.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Knutsford Crown Court – Part 1
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Knutsford and investigate a former Crown Court. Multiple people have been sentenced to death and life in prison, but will the team encounter any of its former inmates tonight?

programme.title: Past Hunters: Knutsford Crown Court – Part 2
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters continue their investigation of Knutsford Crown Court. As they delve deeper into the building, will the ghosts and spirits make contact through Derek?

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Situated near Kentucky's famous Mammoth Caves, the Grand Victorian Inn has carried the hopes of several businesses, residents, educators, and children since it was first erected in 1885. Now, its current owners have experienced a litany of ghostly claims.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The team meets with a paranormal investigator who meticulously kept records on the town jail and has kept in contact with a variety of folks who worked there, including one of the location’s original jailers.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Guests and employees of Hall Place have witnessed furniture moving on its own and apparitions of Civil War Union Soldiers ambling through the halls. The tunnels beneath were reportedly used for the underground railroad.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The historic home of JP Speed has morphed into an Arts College, carrying on the legacy of the local entrepreneur’s second wife, Harriet, who was passionate about sharing her love for music and the humanities and is said to still be haunting the home.

programme.title: The Amityville Horror
programme.desc: Ryan Reynolds och Melissa George spelar huvudrollerna i denna intensiva och gastkramande omtolkning från storfilmsproducenten Michael Bay av en av tidernas mest kända skräckhistorier baserad på sanna händelser.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 2
programme.desc: När ett par välkomnar en nyfödd bebis i sitt hem börjar en demonisk närvaro att terrorisera dem och göra deras perfekta värld till en oundviklig mardröm.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 9
programme.desc: Elle Macpherson enrols the seven remaining contestants in a Fashion Targets Breast Cancer catwalk event for their biggest showcase yet and they also take part in a beauty shoot with a cosmetics company.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 10
programme.desc: The six remaining girls arrive in Barbados and hit the waves for a surfing-themed tourism advert. The action remains on the water for a boat-based photoshoot with Dannii Minogue and a leading hair-care brand, ahead of the dreaded elimination.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 11
programme.desc: The final five star in a music video with Bajan pop group Cover Drive and have to learn a complicated dance routine, before Elle Macpherson challenges the contestants to model jewellery in a photoshoot set in a limestone cavern.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 12
programme.desc: The four remaining girls compete for a place in next week's final, demonstrating what they have learnt by styling themselves for a Bajan magazine cover shoot. After that, Tyson Beckford sets the contestants a challenge at a sugar plantation.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 13
programme.desc: The three remaining contestants take part in their final photoshoot a Caribbean carnival-themed catwalk show infront of an audience of industry bigwigs. Elle Macpherson, Tyson Beckford and Dannii Minogue then select the winner.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Bibbi är sjuksköterska och ska snart gå i pension, men med sina skulder kommer hon inte att kunna gå i pension vid 67 års ålder. Hennes hus är fullt av kläder, smycken och tomma champagneflaskor. Kommer hon att kunna ändra sin livsstil?

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Arild blandar ihop sin privatekonomi med sitt företag och har därför tappat kontrollen. Han har skulder på långt över en miljon kronor. Arild är en skicklig tatuerare, men hur kan han rädda sin ekonomi?

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Hilde slösar bort sin lön som lastbilschaufför på sitt bilintresse. Hon struntar i räkningarna, kylskåpet är tomt, elen är på väg att stängas av och skulderna växer.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Ellinor har sålt sitt hus och är på väg att starta om sitt liv. Trots en bra inkomst har hon det kämpigt. Experterna följer med henne under flyttprocessen och blir chockade över hur mycket pengar som läggs på onödiga inköp.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2501

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2502
programme.desc: Else har skatteskulder och riskerar att bli av med sitt hus. De höga elpriserna och Elses överdrivna konsumtion av kaffe, mat och mobilspel tar över hennes budget och får framtiden att se mörk ut.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2503
programme.desc: Odins liv vändes på sin kant när han sjuk i cancer, och nu hindrar skulderna från tiden innan och under sjukdomen honom från att bygga det liv han vill ha.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge

programme.title: Jet Truck
programme.desc: The Darnell's celebrate their return home by blowing off some pent-up explosive redneck frustration while Brooke tries to keep something very special under wraps.

programme.desc: A new season of Graveyard Carz, the show wherein abandoned and left­for­death classic Mopars are given a new lease on life.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Kolin asks Dan to repair his smashed up 1973 Corvette, but Dan finds major problems that existed before the accident. Jim wants Dan to build him an asphalt crushing 1970 Challenger convertible by adding a 426 Hemi with all the fixin’s.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: Grin and Bear a 'Cuda
programme.desc: The world is littered with the remains of forgotten muscle cars. At Graveyard Carz, some will get a second chance in the hands of Mark Worman and the Ghouls.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Dan and the team take on the restorations of a 1965 Mustang fastback and a 1951 Studebaker truck. The mustang is for a friend whose plans are far bigger than his budget, and the Studebaker needs a unique design to make it a world-class show vehicle.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: FantomWorks epic 4 year long wrestling match with the 1961 International Harvester Metro concludes with an incredible, one-of-a-kind van. Ray wants his 1969 ZL1 to match the number 68 rally car, but he needs Dan’s rare Winters stamped 427 COPO motor.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Larry wants to drive his1959 Cadillac DeVille, but the car has spent decades baking in the Arizona sun. Brian spent years gathering parts to restore his grandfather’s 1960 Bel Air only to find that he’s missing more critical components than he’s found…

programme.desc: Mike thought his 1967 Chevy K10 Pick Up needed paint improvement. Dan quickly realizes that the car needs much more. Nobody restores 1970 Opel Kadett, so there are no parts anywhere for Harry’s car that needs a lot of everything.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Patsy and Apryle bring their 1968 Corvette in for mechanical work, but what their car really needs is a new paint job. Jim’s 1958 Impala is an auction car. It looks pretty but when it’s time to drive – it’s half the car Jim was hoping for.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Kim and Doug want to drive her father’s hyper-rare 1959 Thunderbolt, but the car was only set up for the racetrack. Batalla is a legendary motorcycle builder who asks Dan to restore his prized possession - a 1947 Knucklehead.

programme.title: FantomWorks

programme.title: The Ride Life

programme.title: Harlequin: Broken Lullaby
programme.desc: En föräldralös (Mel Harris) strävan att spåra sitt förflutna börjar med ett barndomsfoto av henne själv bredvid en sällsynt speldosa och leder henne till en förförisk skattjägare. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: At the Midnight Hour
programme.desc: Liz, en vacker barnflicka, ger ny mening åt Richard Keatons liv, en änkeman som blivit vetenskapsman, och hans begåvade son Andy. Liz liv hotas när hon kommer för nära sanningen. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: The Awakening
programme.desc: När en prisjägare, som spårar en av hennes hyresgäster, övertygar Sara McAllister att samarbeta med honom, påbörjar de ett äventyr tillsammans i den farliga världen av internationell spionage och kärlek. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: This Matter of Marriage
programme.desc: Arkitekterna Hallie och Donnalee driver ett stort byggprojekt för en excentrisk miljardär, Adam Barr. Hallie, som har letat efter sin drömman, hittar honom plötsligt i grannhuset. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: Hard to Forget
programme.desc: Privatdetektiven Max Warner är övertygad om att Sandra Applewhites död inte var en olyckshändelse utan att hennes make John Gilman mördade henne. När han möter Sandras tvillingsyster Nicky ber han henne om hjälp. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter

programme.title: Harlequin: Diamond Girl
programme.desc: Playboy-advokaten Denny Montana ger aldrig sin sjaskiga biträdande jurist Claire Bernard en andra blick. Men när han börjar se en oslipad diamant i Claire, börjar han förvandla henne till en förtjusande skönhet. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: The Waiting Game
programme.desc: Sarah och Amy, bästa vänner sedan universitetet, anordnar sin första konstutställning i en liten stad i New England. När gåtfulla främlingar kommer in i deras liv och romantik uppstår utvecklas det utmaningar. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter

programme.title: Harlequin: Loving Evangeline
programme.desc: När Robert får veta om sin brors båtolycka ger han sig ut för att hämta kroppen och möter Evie Shaw, ägare till marinan där hans bror hyrde båten. Han blir besatt av sin brors misstänkta död ... och av Evie. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: Recipe for Revenge
programme.desc: Cateringfirman Carly Westin går med på att förbereda en festmåltid för en vän som vill imponera på en man. Men paret blir dödat när hon är i köket. När polisutredaren Jack blir inblandad måste han skydda Carly. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: A Change of Place
programme.desc: När den oroliga Dominique ber sin bokälskande syster Kimberly att anta rollen som en glamorös parisisk modell i en månad, tvekar Kimberly. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness blir Rob, Steelo och Carly Aquilino lite väl tävlingsinriktade när det ska hjulas i 'Oavsiktlig hjulningsskada', bevittnar tunnelbanekaos i 'Galentåg' och benar ut ett och annat med 'Skelettpolare'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness orsakar Rob, Steelo och Karrueche Tran allvarlig skada när de försöker 'Golfa hemma', träffar byggnadsarbetare som har kul i ' Jobbgycklare' och får bevittna vindens makt i 'Bortblåst'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness går Rob, Steelo och Karrueche Tran på lektion med 'Föreläsnings-sabbare', motar bort hjortar i 'Hjortintrång' och gör volter i 'Gymnastattacker'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculosness glider Rob, Steelo och gästevärden Karrueche Tran runt på gatorna och man är 'Usel på att drifta', käkar lite med folk som vill 'Äta i alla lägen' och ser till att det är full fart på festen i 'Födelsedagsbomber'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av 'Ridiculousness' ska Rob, Steelo och Karrueche Tran använda foam roller i 'Fatal foam', bjuda ut heta dejter på 'Eldiga utekvällar' och sitta bredvid olustigt folk i 'Äckliga passagerare'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av 'Ridiculousness' ska Rob, Steelo och Karrueche Tran ta hand om insekter i 'Kryppatrullen', bli tårögda i 'Kärlekstårar' och skejta på gatan i 'Stanna i parken'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness stöter Rob, Steelo och Karrueche Tran på en ny fara med att dricka i 'Ölsmällar', träffar folk som håller modet uppe när de borde bli nedslagna i 'Kraschglada' och kör hårt i 'Kan inte och tänker inte stanna'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness håller Rob Dyrdek, Steelo Brim och Karrueche Tran avstånd från 'Spökbollsförgörare', undviker att blir träffade av 'Luftsmockor' och hänförs av personer som rör sig smidigt i 'Kanske magi'.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison får en mindre hjärnskakning när hon halkar i badkaret. När hon ska göra en magnetröntgen får hon en märklig vision om en man hon just träffat.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison får problem med att förbli opartisk i ett fall när hon utvecklar moderliga känslor för en tonårspojke som anklagas för att ha mördat sin tidigare chef.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison hjälper distriktsåklagaren att försöka hitta en saknad bror till en nära vän. Hon blir paranoid när det gäller antiterroristagenter från regeringen.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison drömmer att hennes bror var inblandad i ett lokalt bankrån. Hennes misstankar växer när han oväntat dyker upp i staden och blir involverad med en bedragerska.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison undersöker till synes slumpmässiga mord och sätter sin familj i fara i processen. Bridgette måste göra en klasspresentation om sin mammas jobb.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Tre flickor hittas mördade. Allisons visioner kopplar ihop detektiv Scanlon med fallet.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison drömmer upprepade gånger om en kvinna som bevakas av en främling i sitt sovrum.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison är upptagen med att utreda en lokal läkares död när en man som påstår sig vara "Döden" börjar dyka upp i hennes visioner, vilket får henne att oroa sig för att hennes tid i den här världen kanske snart är över.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison drömmer om det liv hon kunde ha fått om hon hade blivit den advokat hon ursprungligen ville bli.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allisons gamla flamma, Clay Bicks, dyker upp vid hennes dörr strax efter att ha dött, ovetandes om att han är död.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison och Bridgette fortsätter att ha samma märkliga drömmar medan Allison kommer närmare att förstå vad drömmarna betyder och hur de hänger samman med en serie skjutningar/mord.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison drömmer om samma dag om och om igen. Varje gång hittar hon fler viktiga ledtrådar. Joe försöker få tillgivenhet från Allison. Ariel har problem i skolan.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: En seriemördare från det förflutna börjar besitta människor så att han kan döda igen. Allison tävlar mot klockan för att rädda hans nästa offer, men hon blir en måltavla i processen.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison ger Joe en videokamera i födelsedagspresent. Men snart börjar hon se störande bilder genom den som kanske eller kanske inte har samband med ett mord.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison hjälper en berömd FBI-profil med ett fall av seriemördare. Joe blir orolig när Marie börjar titta på statiska bilder på TV.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison och Ariel börjar få drömmar om ett brott. De drömmer om det från olika perspektiv, vilket avslöjar två misstänkta personer.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison kallas in för att hjälpa Devalos att utreda den chockerande dödsfallet av en välrespekterad församlingsledamot, men av någon anledning har hon visioner av en ung pojke som är fångad i en brunn.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison drömmer om en märklig vänskap mellan två nyligen mördade spöken. När hon försöker hjälpa ett av spökena att lösa sitt mord blir hon förvånad när han avböjer hennes hjälp.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison har visioner av en missbrukande far och hans unga son, som söker tröst från sin smärta hos en talande docka. Dockan kan dock skicka onda meddelanden till barnet.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Krystle hålls kvar på Delta Rho Farms medan Rita utger sig för att vara henne på herrgården. Dex tillfångatas i Moldavien. Familjen Colby anländer till Denver för att delta i Blakes fest.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Dex iscensätter en dramatisk räddning i Moldavien. Jeff upptäcker en ledtråd till Fallons vistelseort. Little Blake inser att Rita inte är Krystle och Dominique ringer ett mystiskt samtal från utlandet.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Efter att ha kommit i säkerhet läggs den förlamade kung Galen in på sjukhus. Joel utger sig för att vara läkare för att få tillträde till herrgården. Galen ger Alexis ett kraftfullt löfte från sin sjukhussäng.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Sammy Jo får panik när Blake eventuellt upptäcker att Krystle är i fångenskap. Claudia planerar tillsammans med Adam att få tillbaka sin oljekälla. Galen lovar att göra Alexis till en kraftfull kvinna när han försöker återta tronen.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Rita fruktar att bli upptäckt när Blake bokar in ett möte för henne med sin läkare. Galen fortsätter sina intriger för att återta tronen. Michael bestämmer sig enbart för att han och Amanda ska bilda familj.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Joel säger till Rita att hon måste ligga med Blake. Joel och den riktiga Krystle ses tillsammans på en rastgård. Galen skickar Michael till New York för att få hjälp.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: När Blake hotar med skilsmässa vidtar Rita drastiska åtgärder. Galen döljer sitt tillfrisknande när han planerar att återta tronen. Jonathan accepterar en tjänst hos Bart Fallmont.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blake får den dödliga dosen gift. Sammy Jo upptäcker en misstänkt flaska. Krystle försöker fly på två bedrägliga sätt. Ett knytnävsslagsmål bryter ut om rörledningen. Dex kämpar för byggrättigheter.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Galen planerar sin comeback. Alexis förlorade syster dyker upp. Joel och Rita planerar sitt sista drag. Blakes liv är i fara.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Efter att ha fallit ner för trappan måste Blake föras till sjukhus. Adam inser att han är utskriven ur sin fars testamente och försöker desperat övertyga en knappt vid medvetande Blake att skriva under ett nytt dokument.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Krystle utger sig för att vara Rita och flyr. Joel och Rita störtar över en klippa. Alexis planerar Krystles död. Dex konfronterar Galen.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: En förtalande reporter orsakar Krystles känslomässiga sammanbrott. Fallon återvänder hem och döljer en oroande hemlighet. Amanda bestämmer sig för att skilja sig från Michael.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Alexis hittar Amanda och Dex i sängen tillsammans. Krystle vänder på steken mot Alexis. Adam undersöker Bart Fallmonts förflutna.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blakes jakt på Rita och Joel intensifieras. Alexis driver Dex och Amanda tillbaka till varandra medan Blake försöker separera de två. Adam hotar att avslöja Barts hemlighet. Caress gör ett besök hos Alexis.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Krystle och Alexis bråkar om Blake. Bart uttrycker sina sanna känslor för Steven medan en privatdetektiv avslöjar Barts tidigare kärleksaffärer. Garretts misstankar om Jackies far växer.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Alexis tar med sig Ben Carrington till maskeradbalen. Adams plan att utpressa Bart Fallmont förverkligas. Garrett konfronterar Dominique med sina misstankar om att Jackie är hans dotter.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Barts hemliga förflutna ger triumf för Denver-Carrington, men Blake står inför ett möjligt nederlag i rättssalen i striden med sin bror Ben. Dex avvisar Amandas känslor.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Jackie upptäcker att hennes far står som "okänd" på hennes födelseattest. Alexis köper företaget som planerar att ge ut Caress bok.

programme.desc: Reno and his jinxed bounty are captured by a corrupt small-town sheriff.

programme.title: Renegade
programme.desc: Bobby, Reno and Sandy must live together while on a stakeout.

programme.title: Renegade
programme.desc: In the series finale, Reno could prove his innocence and put Dutch in jail.

programme.title: Renegade
programme.desc: Reno Raines , an undercover cop of the Las Vegas police force, finds himself the target of a deadly frame-up and on the run and out to clear his name.

programme.title: Renegade
programme.desc: Reno comes to the rescue of a car in trouble.

programme.title: Renegade
programme.desc: A contract killer is hired to take out a small town judge.

programme.title: Renegade
programme.desc: News reports of Lt. Enrique Vilas escape from El Salvador are accompanied by offers of a $100,000 reward for his capture.

programme.title: Renegade
programme.desc: After a dispute over a repair bill, a young motorcycle mechanic is murdered in cold blood by a maniacal cutthroat.

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E1 - Mind The Baby
programme.desc: Crichton, Aeryn and D'argo are stranded in an asteroid field while Scorpius searches for them. Their safety depends on Crais, who is nearby in Talyn.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E1 - Mind The Baby

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E2 - Vitas Mortis
programme.desc: D'Argo takes part in a sacred ritual that helps an old Luxan, an Orican, to survive.

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E3 - Taking The Stone
programme.desc: Chiana leaves Moya and goes to 'grave planet' populated by reckless thrill seekers who play dangerous and life-threatening games.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E3 - Taking The Stone

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E4 - Crackers Don't Matter
programme.desc: A visitor comes on Moya with a device that could cloak Moya. The crew welcomes him on board, but soon almost everyone is acting paranoid.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E4 - Crackers Don't Matter

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E5 - The Way We Weren't
programme.desc: Chiana discovers a recording with Moya's original Pilot. After seeing the recording and realizing Aeryn was involved, Pilot orders Aeryn to leave Moya
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E5 - The Way We Weren't

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E6 - Picture If You Will
programme.desc: Chiana buys a picture in a store, which is more than it seems. The picture changes and shows Chiana what will happen to her.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E6 - Picture If You Will

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E7 - Home On The Remains
programme.desc: The crew needs food. Zhaan needs to eat meat and starts spewing spores. Only Aeryn seems to have a tolerance for the spores.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E7 - Home On The Remains

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E8 - Dream A Little Dream
programme.desc: While waiting for Moya to pick their Transport Pod, Zhaan tells Crichton of Moya's adventures after the Gammak base was destroyed.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E8 - Dream A Little Dream

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E9 - Out Of Their Minds
programme.desc: An alien ship fires a weapon at Moya. The blast makes it through and causes everyone's consciousness to jump into another body.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E9 - Out Of Their Minds

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E10 - My Three Crichtons
programme.desc: A strange globe appears on Moya, sucking in Crichton and duplicating him creating two additional people.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E10 - My Three Crichtons

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E11 - Look At The Princess, Part 1: A Kiss Is But A Kiss
programme.desc: On a planet about to crown its new monarch. The problem is the Princess cannot ascend unless she finds a genetically compatible mate.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E11 - Look At The Princess, Part 1: A Kiss Is But A Kiss

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E12 - Look At The Princess, Part 2: I Do, I Think
programme.desc: The Queen offers Crichton a choice; marry her daughter the crown princess, or she'll turn him over to Scorpius.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E12 - Look At The Princess, Part 2: I Do, I Think

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E13 - Look At The Princess, Part 3: The Maltese Crichton
programme.desc: John Crichton faces eighty years as a statue. That is, until the Scarran Cargn decapitates the statue and drops the head into a vat of acid.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E13 - Look At The Princess, Part 3: The Maltese Crichton

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E14 - Beware Of Dog
programme.desc: The crew bring aboard an alien tracker to remove some creatures that came aboard hidden in some cargo.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E14 - Beware Of Dog

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E15 - Won't Get Fooled Again
programme.desc: Crichton has returned to Earth. Or has he always been on Earth all this time? People from his past and present appear.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E15 - Won't Get Fooled Again

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E16 - The Locket
programme.desc: A temporal distortion traps Aeryn and John on a planet's surface, where they live out the rest of their lives.

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E17 - The Ugly Truth
programme.desc: Crais and Talyn return. The crew are put on trial for an attack that Talyn made on an alien ship.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E17 - The Ugly Truth

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E18 - A Clockwork Nebari
programme.desc: A Nebari group comes aboard Moya and attempts to mind cleanse everyone using a drug. Pilot and Rygel are the only two who can resist the effects.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E18 - A Clockwork Nebari

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E19 - Liars, Guns And Money, Part 1: A Not So Simple Plan
programme.desc: D'Argo finally gets a lead on his son, Jothee. He will do anything to get him back, but Jothee will be sold as a slave.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E19 - Liars, Guns And Money, Part 1: A Not So Simple Plan

programme.title: The 4400

programme.title: The 4400

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana search for someone who is kidnapping young 4400s. Shawn is threatened by the Nova Group.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: While in one of Alana's fantasies, Tom and Alana see Maia, though they have no memory of her existence. Diana's life is threatened, and Tom brokers a deal with the future to set history straight.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Isabelle seeks revenge on the Nova Group after they attack Shawn. Alana confronts the man responsible for killing her husband and son in a car accident nine years ago.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: With Dennis Ryland's help, NTAC tracks down the remaining members of the Nova Group. Nikki pays Shawn an unexpected visit.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana are drugged with a hallucinogen, which was created from an oil secreted from the hands of a 4400.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Kevin Burkhoff becomes a marked man when his research on promicin is discovered. Tom and Diana search for Kevin, but discover how far he will go to protect his work. Shawn meets his idol at the 4400 Center.
programme.sub-title: The Ballad Of Kevin And Tess

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana's investigation into a series of gruesome murders leads them to uncover another conspiracy within the government. At the 4400 Center, Shawn receives a gift from another returnee that allows him to see his future.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: NTAC and the 4400 Center work together to find Jordan Collier. Kyle Baldwin gets a surprising visitor at the state prison.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Nova Group members that were in the custody of NTAC escape from jail with outside help from Jordan Collier. Diana tells April about her relationship with Ben. Shawn and Richard learn that Isabelle is working with Dennis Ryland.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana continue their investigation on Jordan Collier's plan for mankind. Dennis Ryland returns to NTAC. Isabelle is seriously injured when she takes a classroom hostage.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A high school student develops an ability after injecting promicin. Tom visits Isabelle in jail, while Diana searches for her missing sister. Following the advice of a young woman named Cassie, Kyle is able to wake Shawn from his coma.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana search for a person who has the ability to make people's worst fears come to life. Danny seeks Shawn's help in finding a promicin shot. Cassie leads Kyle to a book that contains a prophecy about Jordan Collier.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Audrey Parker develops the ability to astral project herself. However, after she is murdered, Audrey attempts to use her ability to lead Tom and Diana to her killer.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: April's new ability endangers her life. Shawn is approached to run for public office, while Kyle helps Isabelle.
programme.sub-title: The Truth And Nothing But The Truth

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: After realizing Tom knows he is promicin-positive, Kyle joins Jordan in a remote town called Evanston. Tom follows Kyle, and learns the remarkable truth about Evanston: all of its residents are promicin-positive.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series

programme.title: The Millers: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man
programme.desc: When Ray points out that Nathan has a history of being the worst wingman ever, Nathan embarks on a mission to be a better friend by becoming less self-involved.
programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.
programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: The Millers: Papa Was a Rolling Bone
programme.desc: The Millers decide to spend Thanksgiving apart for the first time ever, but they rethink the new family tradition when all their individual Turkey Day plans hit unexpected snags.

programme.title: The Millers: Louise Louise
programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.
programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.title: The Millers: Give Metta World Peace a Chance
programme.desc: Nathan lands the biggest interview of his career with professional basketball player Metta World Peace, but when karma catches up with him, he risks ruining his professional reputation.
programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: His Way

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Shadows And Symbols

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Duet

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: En av de nya gästerna visar sig ha ett förflutet med en av killarna, till hans partners stora förtret. Ett svek uppdagas som vänder upp och ner på hela hotellet.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Skärselden fortsätter att locka fler offer och ett oväntat erbjudande dyker upp. Hur långt är man beredd att gå för att ta sig vidare? Dessutom har det blivit dags för säsongens första Pandoras Ask.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Det uppdagas att flera på hotellet har blivit erbjudna samma sak, utan varandras vetskap, och stämningen blir minst sagt kylig. Parceremonin närmar sig, men innan dess ska en av tjejerna checka ut.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: En av eleverna tvingas checka ut när Frökens Favorit tar hans partner, och fler elever börjar känna kärleken spira. Skolans Värsting gör entré och det är ingen duvunge som kommer.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Vem målade Mona-Lisa? Och är Kuwait ett land eller en frukt? Nya prövningar väntar eleverna när en immunitet står på spel. Dessutom rör en dagsfest upp starka känslor – precis innan parceremonin.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: En lojal partner är A och O på Paradise Hotel men, en back up är minst lika viktigt. Ytterligare en kille tvingas lämna hotellet och den efterföljande festen får svartsjuka att blossa upp.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Cirkusen har anlänt till Paradiset men, faror lurar i manegen. En galen mördarclown är lös på hotellet och när som helst kan någon bli mördad och tvingas checka ut.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Festen får svartsjukan att frodas och teorierna om vem som är hotellets mördarclown går isär. Två spådamer checkar in för att hjälpa till att lösa mysteriet men, vad är egentligen den röda tråden?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Pandoras Ask kommer aldrig lägligt men kanske extra olägligt just ikväll. En allians ”behind the scenes” blir allt starkare, men kommer spådamerna att lyssna på den alliansen eller inte?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Det är aldrig kul när en annan tjej vill ha ens kille och speciellt inte på Paradise Hotel. Hemliga allianser riskerar att avslöjas när parceremonin tvingar alla att visa sina rätta färger.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Är det ostvecka på hotellet? Dags för lederhosen och dirndl när gästerna hamnat i Alperna. Ett välbekant ansikte checkar in, redo att ge allt och bara tänka på sig själv.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: En av killarna lägger näsan i… smink, och frågan är hur det kommer påverka spelet för hans del framöver. Ytterligare ett känt ansikte gör entré, redo att hämnas på sina motståndare.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Hotellets after ski bjuder på både bråk och kaos. Svartsjukan bubblar över för ett av paren och den stela stämningen sprider sig på hotellet.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Det mytomspunna hotellet på Mexikos dramatiska västkust slår återigen upp portarna och det är ett taggat gäng som checkar in. Men, allt kan hända på Paradise Hotel och särskilt i händerna på JLC.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: JLC fortsätter styra premiärveckan med järnhand och redan andra dagen kommer tiden på hotellet vara över för några av gästerna. Starka känslor har etablerats mellan flera av deltagarna.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Ny vecka i Paradiset och frågan är om hotellet är en himmel eller ett helvete? Hemligheter avslöjas och två nya gäster checkar in för att röra om ordentligt i grytan.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.
programme.sub-title: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.desc: Castalianere går om bord på Andromeda for at færdiggøre charteret for det nye Commonwealth. Da lederen bliver fundet død, er Tyr den hovedmistænkte.

programme.title: Andromeda: Perlerne, der var hans øjne
programme.desc: Beka finder ud af, at hendes fars tidligere forretningspartner handler med et stærkt vanedannende stof kaldet F lash

programme.title: Andromeda: Tårernes matematik
programme.desc: Andromeda opdager sit søsterskib, Pax Magellanic. Besætningen om bord på Pax er 300 år gammel... men er ikke blevet ældre en eneste dag.

programme.title: Andromeda: Musik fra en fjern tromme
programme.desc: Tyr nødlander Eureka Maru på en nietzscheansk planet og får hukommelsestab. Han skal huske, hvad han laver, før nietzscheanerne opdager ham og hans kasse med stjålne varer.

programme.title: Andromeda: Harper 2.0
programme.desc: Harper modtager viden fra en døende Perseid, men opdager først, at Perseid blev eftersøgt af en dusørjæger, som nu har rettet sin opmærksomhed mod Harper.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tvunget perspektiv
programme.desc: Dylan bliver arresteret for at have myrdet en diktator for 300 år siden.

programme.title: Andromeda: Summen af dens dele
programme.desc: Andromeda bliver bordet af en drone fra Consensus of Parts, et mytisk mekanisk samfund. Ibegyndelsen er dronen venlig, men den forsøger at tvinge skibet til at slutte sig til Consensus.

programme.title: Andromeda: Frygt og afsky i Mælkevejen
programme.desc: Gerentex er tilbage, og han kræver, at Trance og Harper hjælper ham med sin nye plan: at finde Tarn-Vedra.

programme.title: Andromeda: Djævelen tager det længste strå
programme.desc: Dylan og Rev Bem hjælper et fredeligt samfund med at stå op mod deres potentielle slavehandlere.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hair of the Dog
programme.desc: Investigators are baffled after finding a murder scene devoid of any physical evidence, but they suspect that the victim's dog had witnessed the crime. If so, forensic scientists would have to find some way to learn what the dog had seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pastoral Care
programme.desc: In 1981, New York correctional officer Donna Payant disappeared and was later found in a landfill. The medical examiner not only identified the cause of death, but also found an important clue.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bitter Potion
programme.desc: Flu-like symptoms of a mother and her children prove to be something more serious: thallium poisoning. After the mother's death, investigators turn their attention to finding the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cloak of Deceit
programme.desc: For seven years, a trio of men robbed one bank after another. They always got away before the police arrived and they left no evidence behind. But the way they stood and the clothes they wore told a story that could be read by forensic scientists.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Over and Out
programme.desc: When a pipe bomb rips through a rural home, police have no idea who is responsible. A 9-volt battery and the remnants of a mailing label ead investigators to the man who made the bomb.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Printed Proof
programme.desc: When two women went missing and were later found brutally murdered, police wondered if they were victims of a hate crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Palm Saturday
programme.desc: In 2007, Brian and Beverly Mauck were found dead in their Graham, Washington home. Using a bloody palm print and shoe prints at the scene, investigators focus their attention on Daniel Tavares, who had previously inked a tattoo on Brian's back.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: In 1999, Susan Fassett was gunned down as she left her church choir practice in Poughkeepsie, NY. After clearing her husband, police turned their attention to Fred Andros, with whom Susan had an affair.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hack Attack
programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of jobs. Forensic investigators had to determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error, or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smoking Out a Killer
programme.desc: A college senior was found raped and murdered near an unpaved footpath used by students to walk from one side of campus to the other.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All Wet
programme.desc: A woman's death in Pennsylvania triggers a homicide investigation into another woman's death in North Carolina. Faced with striking similarities, examiners must determine if their suspect's story about accidental drowning is all wet.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sands of Crime
programme.desc: In the early hours of a morning just before Christmas, a college student was abducted from the parking lot of her apartment. Her body was found later that day; she had been sexually assaulted and shot at point-blank range.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Core Evidence
programme.desc: In 1996, more than a dozen children in Seattle, Washington, were fighting for their lives. Each one of them had contracted a serious unknown illness. After one died, investigators knew the clock was ticking.

programme.title: Forensic Files: House Call
programme.desc: A murder investigation in Florida crosses jurisdictions from New York and Jamaica. The police rely on cell phone mapping, wiretapping and a host of forensic evidence to link a suspect to a murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wheel of Misfortune
programme.desc: Casino security cameras tracked a young woman's movements until shortly before she disappeared. She was never seen again, but through the evidence she left behind, she was able to tell investigators what happened to her and who was responsible.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pet Rock
programme.desc: In 1995, Palm Beach waitress Denise O'Neill is abducted and murdered. Her neighbor Luis Caballero arouses suspicions by behaving oddly towards TV crews covering the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Home Evasion
programme.desc: In 2000, Judy Southern arrived home from work and was shot by a gunman waiting within. Her husband arrived shortly afterwards, called emergency services and drove her to the hospital.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The House That Roared
programme.desc: A woman disappears and her husband becomes the prime suspect — especially after police find a huge bloodstain on the carpet of their bedroom. When they spray the bedroom with Luminol, they discover it was awash with blood spatter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Burning Desire
programme.desc: Investigators sift through the ashes of a fire which killed a 40-year-old woman. The fire appears to have been started by an unattended cigarette. On closer look, forensic scientists discover the cause was far more complicated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cold Hearted
programme.desc: When a young fireman died from what appeared to be serious but undiagnosed heart disease, his family and friends had no proof of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Soft Touch
programme.desc: In 1992, 22-year-old Dawn Bruce is brutally murdered in her Virginia apartment. Investigators notice a blood smear on a pillow case that appears to have been made by one of the killer's fingers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pressed for Crime
programme.desc: Several suspects and conflicting evidence complicated a brutal murder investigation. But the forensics were clear on one thing: the killer knew his victim, and that alone gave investigators a head start.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Financial Downfall
programme.desc: A beautiful young woman falls to her death from a cliff overlooking the ocean. Initially, investigators think it was a tragic accident. But after a forensic examination, police uncover a very different picture of what happened.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Calculated Coincidence
programme.desc: A young woman is found dead in her apartment. With little evidence at the scene, the case turns cold — until police discover a link between their prime suspect and an unsolved murder committed six years earlier in a different state.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Frozen Assets
programme.desc: In 2004, Mary Ann Clibbery was found brutally murdered at her Illinois business. Investigators had to determine if this was a robbery gone wrong or a calculated murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Up in Smoke
programme.desc: When an elderly couple died in a suspicious house fire, their son became the prime suspect. Investigators turned to forensic science to determine if the fire had been set deliberately, or if it was an unfortunate accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Letter Perfect
programme.desc: A healthy young man dies mysteriously in his sleep and toxicology tests reveal a lethal dose of lidocaine in his blood. Investigators find a suicide note and presume he killed himself until a forensic linguist examines the note.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dark Waters
programme.desc: When a hit-and-run boating accident caused the death of a popular young man, investigators faced the daunting task of searching for one boat among 1200 others.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Making the Collar
programme.desc: The body of 16-year-old Leanne Tiernan was discovered nine months after she disappeared. Forensic scientists found clues that painted a virtual portrait of her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Planted Evidence
programme.desc: One morning in a deserted area outside of Phoenix, a motorcyclist discovers the body of a young woman. She had been beaten, bound, strangled and possibly raped. Nearby plants tell investigators more about the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Guarded Secrets
programme.desc: A security guard disappeared from his post without a trace; his remains were found a year later in a remote campsite.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dirty Laundry
programme.desc: The victim was a self-made man who never minced words. Perhaps he was murdered by a disgruntled client or employee. Perhaps the racy photos in his safe held the clue to solving the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ties That Bind
programme.desc: Who was the sexual offender who murdered two adolescent boys in Nebraska? The key to stopping him would be the unique composition of the "junk rope" he used to tie his victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Welcome Intrusion
programme.desc: A man tells police he shot an intruder who had attacked and murdered his wife. The husband paints a tragic picture and is dubbed a hero. Four years later, forensic evidence leads police to re-examine the motives of this so-called hero.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Broken Promises
programme.desc: When a popular gym teacher is found dead of what appears to be an accidental gunshot wound, his family is suspicious. A tape recorded by the victim just before his death tells the true story of his strange marriage and his wife's insatiable greed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign of the Crime
programme.desc: In little more than a month, two women who lived in the same apartment complex were brutally murdered. The similarities of the crime scenes led police to conclude they were dealing with a serial killer who harbored an intense hatred of women.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wood-be Killer

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: You Told Her?!
programme.desc: Heidi og Spencer er chokerede over at finde ud af, at deres adfærd er blevet et diskussionsemne. Audrina skal træffe en beslutning om både Brody og Sean; og Caroline gør sine sande følelser for Kaitlynn klart.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I'm Back in LA Bitches!
programme.desc: Slænget fejrer Kristin Cavallaris besøg i LA. Spændingerne vokser mellem Heidi & Audrina. Justin & Jason styrker deres venskab. En god nat bliver til en god morgen, da Brody og Audrina endelig sætter deres kemi på prøve.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: "Who Slept at Your House?"
programme.desc: Da Kristin udspørger Brody om hans "sleepover" med Audrina, svirrer rygterne, og Kaitlynn føler sig udenfor. Caroline konfronterer Kaitlynn over deres venskab, der ligger på is, og Jason hører, at Spencer sætter spørgsmålstegn ved hans ædruelighed.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Get Dessert and Bail
programme.desc: Brody og Audrinas flirt tager fart. Krigen mellem familien Pratt og Wahler når kogepunktet, mens Brandon er ude i kulden efter Danis kølige svar til, om de skal flytte sammen. Audrina og Heidis venskab står ved en skillevej.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Time Heals Not Some Things
programme.desc: Heidi og Spencer søger hjælp til deres skrantende økonomi. Mens Kaitlynns nye forhold stadig trives, truer en flirt fra Brandons fortid forholdet til Dani. Justin forsones med sin far efter en svær tid.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: That's Math Right There
programme.desc: Kaitlynns beslutning om at flytte sammen med sin fyr får alle til at undre sig over, hvad der foregår. Heidi & Spencer er bekymrede for deres firma, og mens Brandon revurderer sit forhold, indser Audrina nogle ting om Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: What About Me?
programme.desc: Ved Speidis helseretreat flyver rygterne om Kaitlynns graviditet. Brandon afslører chokerende nyt om sit forhold. Wahler-familien prøver at blive forsonet med Pratt-familien, der distraheres af mulige ændringer i deres eget liv.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Timing Is Everything
programme.desc: Kaitlynn fortæller Brody, at hun er gravid, men bekymrer sig om, at han og Kris skal mødes på retreatet. Pratts og Wahlers forholder sig endelig til den fejde, der har splittet gruppen.

programme.title: The Hills: New City, New Drama
programme.desc: Lauren Conrad jonglerer sin designeruddannelse, et krævende praktikantophold og en uforudsigelig bofælle, der saboterer hendes jobevent, så hun lærer hurtigt, at alt er større i L.A., inklusive hendes problemer.

programme.title: The Hills: A Change of Plans
programme.desc: Da Heidi får et interview til et 'drømmejob', der får hende til at overveje at droppe skolen, indser Lauren, at hun og Heidi er på vej i forskellige retninger.

programme.title: The Hills: An Unexpected Call
programme.desc: Teen Vogue sender Lauren væk på et ærinde til New York, og da hun vender tilbage til L.A. venter der en stor overraskelse fra hendes fortid. Heidi indser, at arbejdet som festarrangør ikke er en stor fest.

programme.title: The Hills: Lauren and Jason: Part 2
programme.desc: Da Jason, Laurens eks fra Laguna Beach, dukker op i hendes liv igen, indser Lauren, at hun måske ikke er kommet sig over ham. I sit nye job spørger Heidi om prisen er for høj.

programme.title: The Hills: Jason's Birthday
programme.desc: Lauren skynder sig hjem fra et Teen Vogue-event for at være sammen med Jason på hans fødselsdag, men aftenen går ikke som forventet. Audrina beder om Heidis råd til hendes seneste date med model/skuespiller Danny.

programme.title: The Hills: Boyfriends and Work Don't Mix
programme.desc: Jason bliver en stor distraktion i Laurens professionelle og akademiske liv. Heidi får endelig sin store chance for at arbejde på natklubberne, men den kunne ikke være kommet på et værre tidspunkt.

programme.title: The Hills: Somebody Always Has to Cry
programme.desc: Det er slængets første ferie i L.A., men ikke alle får, hvad de har ønsket sig. Lauren får svært ved at få et nytårskys, da hun får et uventet opkald fra en gammel flamme.

programme.title: The Hills: You Can't Just Be With Me?
programme.desc: Jason vil gøre Laurens 20 års fødselsdag speciel, men da hun lyver om at arbejde med mandlige modeller til en opgave for Teen Vogue, bliver deres forhold sat på prøve.
programme.sub-title: You Can't Just Be With Me?

programme.title: The Hills: Love is Not a Maybe Thing
programme.desc: Heidi beslutter omsider, at hun har haft nok drama med Jordan. Lauren og Jason tænker på at tage tingene videre til det næste niveau.
programme.sub-title: Love is Not a Maybe Thing

programme.title: The Hills: Timing is Everything
programme.desc: Da Laurens hårde arbejde til modeugen i L.A. fører til en alle tiders karrieremulighed, er hun splittet mellem sit job og sin fyr.

programme.title: The Hills: Out With The Old
programme.desc: Efter en svær sommer med sin fyr Jason, beslutter Lauren at slå op og venter tilbage til Teen Vogue for at møde sin utilfredse chef. Heidi får problemer med en fyr, som både hun og Audrina dater.

programme.title: The Hills: When You Least Expect It
programme.desc: Lauren tager på sin første date efter Jason og bliver sat på prøve, da hun bliver bedt om at arbejde til en modeopvisning. Heidi har en livsforandrende hemmelighed, som hun må fortælle sin fyr.

programme.title: The Hills: The Best Night Ever
programme.desc: Da en ikke inviteret Audrina dukker op til Heidis fødselsdag, finder hun ud af, at Heidi ikke er parat til at tilgive og glemme. Lauren vil fokusere på sit arbejde, men falder for den charmerende nye fyr i sit liv, Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: Who Do You Trust?
programme.desc: Audrina fortæller Heidi om Spencers utroskab, men Heidi tvivler - indtil hun ser det selv. Lauren tvivler stadig på, om hun er parat til et forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: One Big Interruption
programme.desc: Heidi holder en pause fra Spencer, men savner ham mere end hun havde håbet på. Lauren skal planlægge en middag for Teen Vogue, men ryger i baggrunden til fordel for superpraktikanten Emily fra New York.

programme.title: The Hills: You Have Chosen

programme.title: The Hills: With Friends Like These...
programme.desc: Lauren indser, at hun ikke kan stole på sine bedste venner, efter Heidi fører Jen og Brody sammen.

programme.title: The Hills: Enough Is Enough
programme.desc: Spencer beder Heidi flytte ind med ham, men Heidi ved ikke, hvad hun skal gøre, eller hvordan hun skal fortælle det til sin bofælle Lauren.

programme.desc: Laurens 21. Fødselsdag er fuld af overraskelser, da Heidi og Audrina holder en fest for hende. Jen prøver at slutte fred med Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: Apology Not Accepted
programme.desc: Lauren fylder 21 og Heidi har store planer for fødselsdagsfesten. Men inden festen beslutter Heidi, det er tid til at fortælle Lauren om Spencers idé om at flytte sammen.

programme.title: The Hills: Everyone Falls
programme.desc: Med udsigt til et nyt job, falder Whitney over sin største mulighed med Teen Vogue. Spencer går for vidt, da han presser Heidi til at forlade Lauren og flytte ind med ham.

programme.title: The Hills: Goodbye for Now
programme.desc: I sæsonfinalen tilspidses tingene, da Heidi beslutter at flytte ind med Spencer. Lauren vil have Audrina til at fylde tomrummet efter hendes bedste veninde, og Whitney flyver til New York til et interview.

programme.title: The Hills: You Know What You Did
programme.desc: Lauren går ikke til Heidi and Spencers housewarming fordi Heidi har spredt rygter om hende. Så da Lauren løber ind i Heidi har de et kæmpe skænderi.

programme.title: The Hills: Big Girls Don't Cry
programme.desc: Lauren og Heidi bliver endnu mere uvenner da Spencer frier til Heidi. Audrina finder sammen med en ekskæreste og Lauren vender hjem til Laguna Beach for at få et godt råd.

programme.title: The Hills: Truth And Time Tells All
programme.desc: Lauren prøver at hjælpe Audrina med at beslutte om Justin har kærestekvalitet, men Audrina har allerede truffet sin beslutning. Heidi finder ud af, at det ikke er lutter lagkage at være forlovet.

programme.title: The Hills: Meet The Parents
programme.desc: Ifølge mig: et komisk twist på din yndlings reality-serie. Fra Lauren til Spencer og alle de andre, intet bitchy look eller bromance udelades af skuespilleren, der spilleralle de medvirkende.

programme.title: The Hills: Rolling With The Enemy
programme.desc: Heidis sociale omgangskreds krymper da Spencer 'slår op' med Brody fordi han har hængt ud med Lauren. Audrina vil være fast kæreste med Justin, men det nægter han at gå med til.

programme.title: The Hills: Second Chances

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Breaking Winter Balls

programme.desc: En løgnedetektortest får alle i huset til at gå i panik og får et stærkt par til at miste tilliden i deres forhold, og Georgia finder endelig ud af sandheden om Callum og Paris.

programme.desc: Sandhedsceremonien skaber kaos i huset, og parrene skal beslutte, om de vælger deres eks, næste eller alene. En single stiller det store spørgsmål mens en anden forlader huset, fordi sandheden er for svær at bære.
